The Brightest Light.PreRequisites: Any goodly being shall be allowed in. Any neutral beings must have a signature from the guild head written on their card. No evil beings allowed at all.
The Brightest Light.Ethos: "The light will guide us" - We act on those doing and harbouring evil: bringing light and hope into the darkest places. Defeating evil in all its forms in different ways. "Our strength is our Mercy and War" - We show mercy to every 'living' person even if evil. We show kindness in asking them to redeem and repent their ways but if they reject the light and intend to do harm then they shall die out with the darkness. "Free will is to be celebrated" - Evil clouds people's minds forcing or tricking them into a life of darkness leading people into being hated. Enjoy freedom as you have it. "Brother and sisterhood keeps us strong" - All who are members are expected to strengthen the guild, to recruit new members to our ranks, and to be shining examples for others to follow.
The Brightest Light.Restrictions: No guild member is allowed to hurt another except in purest self defence or in a duel.

Basic.Name: The Light Within
Basic.Effect: Gains immunity to alignment change. If already owned can spend 1 minute in prayer with another goodly individual and grant them immunity to alignment change.

Basic.Name: Gaze upon the light 1/day
Basic.Effect: Mantic light range centred on the user.

Basic.Name: I drive the Evil back 1/day
Basic.Effect: Acts as per the Gold Spell Warding, but only functions on Evil.

Intermediate.Name: Call to the light
Intermediate.Effect:
When used choose one of: 
i: Empower a protection from Evil spirits when cast to act as a Stronghold of Goodness. 
ii: Empower a bless when cast to act as a shield blessing. 
iii: Empower a weapon so it inflicts +0 magic (light based) damage for 5 minutes.

Intermediate.Name: Immunity to Unholy Words
Intermediate.Effect: Gains Immunity to Unholy Words for 5 minutes, can be used retroactively.

Intermediate.Name: Gaze upon the light
Intermediate.Effect:
Choose one on use: 
i: Mantic light range centred on the user. 
ii: Mantic flash and Blinding flash vs evil.

Intermediate.Name: +1 level of resistance
Intermediate.Effect: to any attack that targets the member because they are goodly (EG Prot vs Good, Voice of Retribution vs good).

The Brood.PreRequisites: Evil characters may only join with guildmasters permission. Outlaws may only join/remain a member with guildmasters permission.
The Brood.Ethos:
When Sirac was first created he was commanded to be sure he left the world a better place than he found it. A mission he has found challenging on his own, especially given his low tolerance for politics.

As such he seeks to share the load with those closest to him, be they friends or family. This is a sister guild to the Sons and Daughters of Sirac, but open to any and all who share Sirac’s desire to work within the laws of each land to improve life for the people of those lands.

We seek to improve the life of most who reside within the lands of Primus, and all othersuch lands we come to know. Working within the current political structures and legal systems, but not averse to seeking to improve them where possible. It is very much in keeping with membership of this guild to seek positions of political power, but such should be sought for the benefits you can bring to the land, not yourself.

Principal ethos is “To leave all worlds a better place than you found them”
The Brood.Restrictions:
Anyone found to have knowingly placed their own self interest or other such selfish motives above the welfare of the land and its people will be cast out. It is acceptable to favour your own homeland, but when it would not cause conflict to your oaths and loyalties, you should endeavour to improve the lives of the people of all lands across the cosmos. Equally you must never be found to have deliberately, of your own volition, sought to bring harm to any other member of The Brood or Sons and Daughters of Sirac.

Invariably complex situations arise, Sirac is more than familiar with those, and will judge each case accordingly. The expectation is simply for members of The Brood to do their best for all lands and their peoples, and to treat each other as family, do that and there will be no problem.

Castings out will be at the guild heads discretion entirely, but can have significant ramifications if the guild head feels such is truly deserved.

Basic.Name: True Believer (Gold)
Basic.Effect: This can be used to cast a standard Gold spell.

Basic.Name: Strength of the Ivory Dragon
Basic.Effect: Acts as a single rune of Ivory warrior, but lasts for 1 hour. Additional extra runes of Ivory warrior can be cast on top of this lasting their normal duration with this counting as the 1st.

Intermediate.Name: Diverse Family
Intermediate.Effect: Major prayer about any subject. However the answer must be spun into some odd story involving a tale someone told you about Sirac. Others can never hear this comm or otherwise get the answer until you tell the tale.

Intermediate.Name: Mark ally at will
Intermediate.Effect: for 1 TBLP. If owned already then now costs 0 TBLP.

Intermediate.Effect: Gold Drave innates gained from The Brood can now be cast on Others.

Intermediate.Name: Ivory warrior's from The Brood last for 1 hour
Intermediate.Effect: Ivory warrior's from The Brood last for 1 hour

Advanced.Name: Strength of family
Advanced.Effect: Gains 1 point of live to minus per member of `The Brood` on dungeon, this will not stack with any form of temp life.

Advanced.Name: Embrace the Magic
Advanced.Effect: can double the duration of a published Ivory or Gold spell that would normally last 5 minutes.

Advanced.Name: True Believer (Gold)
Advanced.Effect: Cast a standard or any published Gold spell up to 12 mana

Advanced.Name: Mobility
Advanced.Effect: Mobility from The Brood is now retroactive.

Basic.Name: Discern Supernatural Power User
Basic.Effect: This is the character's primary powerbase or physical if they have none.

Basic.Name: Counter Rite
Basic.Effect: Mantic Deny Power in all ways except with the verbal: “The Circle denies thy power!” but only applies against effects targeting self or another Circle member.

Basic.Name: Elemental Rite of Defence
Basic.Effect: +1 MAC applicable versus attacks from Hedge Wizards, Demonkind or Fey. Rises to +2 MAC if 2 additional Claws of the circle members are on adventure.

Basic.Name: Spiritual Rite of Defence
Basic.Effect: +1 SAC applicable versus attacks from Hedge Wizards, Demonkind or Fey. Rises to +2 SAC if 2 additional Claws of the circle members are on adventure.

Intermediate.Name: Discern Supernatural Power User
Intermediate.Effect: Reveals the type of power owned for 3 TBLP per use.

Intermediate.Name: Counter Rite

Advanced.Name: Discern Supernatural Power User
Advanced.Effect: will now reveal if an individual is a member of the Circle, a Hedge, or other power user.

Claws of the Circle.PreRequisites: Must be a Baronial native, this does include Baronial Demonkind and members of the Ritter orders who are loyal to the Circle.
Claws of the Circle.Ethos: The Claws of Circle is a subsection of The Circle, which is sustained by The Circle, rather than the Volksraad. The guild is one formed to support the political ideals of The Circle and is mainly comprised of militant Circle members with direct approaches to dealing with problems. Members of this guild tend to be on the move most of the time, travelling about the lands covertly performing the will of The Circle.
Claws of the Circle.Restrictions:
• If it is within their means then guild members should attempt to capture or kill any Baronial hedge wizard they encounter in the Baronies.
• Must support the basic political principles of the Southern Baronies.

The Deci Gentlemen's Club.PreRequisites: Guild member must be a person who was born or is resident within the jurisdiction of the City of Deci.
The Deci Gentlemen's Club.Ethos: The basis of the guild is for the future of Deci. Members have banded together to form Political and Military support for the city and nearby villages. This guild believes in using all the citizens of Deci for the defence and the improvement of the city and has no worries if the members use the powers of good or evil so long as all strive for one thing; the future of the lives of the people of Deci and the Empire.
The Deci Gentlemen's Club.Restrictions: Guild Members are required to act in the best interests of the city of Deci. Those failing to do so may be cast from the guild, and while within the City of Deci are at -1 level of resistance.

Basic.Name: Shrouded
Basic.Effect: May call upon the ritual shroud that protects the privacy of the club. This grants complete immunity to all forms of information effects for 5 minutes. Requires 30 seconds of quiet preparation in order to be able to call upon the ritual shroud.

Intermediate.Name: Shrouded
Intermediate.Effect: When using Shrouded can choose to also gain the benefits of a Mantic Pass Unknown.

Intermediate.Name: The Darkness of Deci
Intermediate.Effect: Grants See through Supernatural Darkness for 5 minutes. If already owned instead gains Senseless Vision.

Basic.Name: An Eye for the Unusual
Basic.Effect: Acts as a one use enhanced evaluate vs an object/relic (e.g. a treasure Indiana jones might want to grab).

Basic.Effect: Gains a dungeon temp item of a single use standard spell to 6th level or handbook miracle to 4th.

Basic.Name: Tagged and bagged
Basic.Effect: If returning a "dangerous artefact" to the inquisition that had an ISP value gains 500 grulls per ISP as payment. This must be done at the debrief and the ISP are used in doing this. The guild must have been battle boarded that day to use this.

Intermediate.Name: Eye for the Unusual.
Intermediate.Effect: An Eye for the Unusual may now also be used on active rituals, altars or similar.

Intermediate.Name: You might need this
Intermediate.Effect: Also Gains 10 power (mana or spirits) of useful scrolls chosen by the ref at the start of the day.

Intermediate.Name: Watch Out
Intermediate.Effect: Danger sense with regards to approaching/touching/using relics/artefacts based on the object (e.g. anyone touching this suffers a touch of death would trigger danger sense, the unconnected trap that happens to be under it would not).

Intermediate.Name: Tagged and bagged
Intermediate.Effect: now provides 750 grulls per ISP.

Advanced.Name: Eye for the Unusual.
Advanced.Effect: Now counts as having the relevant “Rec” for an Eye for the Unusual if effected by the relevant powerbase (e.g. Elves cannot count as having rec spirit, but can have rec mana).

Advanced.Name: Eye for the Unusual
Advanced.Effect: Can use all three innate an Eye for the Unusual's on an object and it will act as an Investigation (as the Silver spell) of the relevant power bases.

Advanced.Name: You might need this
Advanced.Effect: item from basic tier can now be any standard spell or miracle.

Department of Recoveries and Collections.PreRequisites: Open to anyone able to understand and work for the Empire. Outlaws and individuals Ostracised by the Empire cannot join, or remain members.
Department of Recoveries and Collections.Ethos: The Department of Recoveries and Collections are a small department in the inquisition that are responsible for finding, securing and making safe artefacts of power. Their mandate covers Primus but their primary work is done in the Empire of Glass via requests from other Imperial departments or private requests.
Department of Recoveries and Collections.Restrictions: Characters cannot be outlawed and cannot gain any benefits while they are outlawed. They must never fail to hand in a dangerous artefact to their employer or if not to an Inquisition office (desk).

Overrides.DisplayName: The People of Sweethaven have spoken
Overrides.Effect:
At the start of the day (in the brief) Duke's Head members can vote which threat (from the below) will be the most dangerous that day. Depending on which wins all members gain the following benefit:
i:The Ghoul is the most dangerous - Gains a War Cry 1/day
ii: The Demons Fire will consume us - Gains + 2 MAC vs Red
iii: The Silver Folk will be our bane - Gains + 3 NAC.

Basic.Name: Cannot be forced on how to vote

Overrides.DisplayName: The People of Sweethaven have spoken
Overrides.Effect:
At the start of each section Duke's Head members may vote which threat (from the below) will be the most dangerous that day. Depending on which wins all members gain the following benefit:
i:The Ghoul is the most dangerous - Gains a War Cry 1/day
ii: The Demons Fire will consume us - Gains + 2 MAC vs Red
iii: The Silver Folk will be our bane - Gains + 3 NAC.

Intermediate.Name: Understanding of freewill
Intermediate.Effect: After spending 30 seconds talking to someone is aware if they are under a domination effect. With a further 30 seconds they gain a major prayers worth of information on what the broad orders are.

Overrides.Effect: Acts as Discipline, but may target another willing Duke's Head member who is claiming guild benefits.

The Duke's Head Society.PreRequisites:
Characters from Sweethaven can join freely.
Anyone else interested in furthering the cause of Sweethaven can join & battleboard the guild, but after 3 outings they must have their candidacy agreed upon (typically by guild vote or otherwise joining Sweethaven) and cannot battleboard the guild further until this is done.
Those with any formal position outside of Sweethaven, including military positions like Legionaries and Samurai, must have both their prospective membership and their candidacy agreed by the guild publicly, which will be announced to those overseeing their position
The Duke's Head Society.Ethos:
Support the Free Republic of Sweethaven in blazing the trail for a better world.
Defend the rights of peons across the world.
Stand up against the tyranny of the Great Freedom and any feudal system.
Share Sweethaven's way of life with anyone who'll listen.
Hone your beliefs through debate, discussion and collective decision-making.
The Duke's Head Society.Restrictions:
Characters from Sweethaven can join freely.
Anyone else interested in furthering the cause of Sweethaven can join & battleboard the guild, but after 3 outings they must have their candidacy agreed upon (typically by guild vote or otherwise joining Sweethaven) and cannot battleboard the guild further until this is done.
Those with any formal position outside of Sweethaven, including military positions like Legionaries and Samurai, must have both their prospective membership and their candidacy agreed by the guild publicly, which will be announced to those overseeing their position

Enclave.PreRequisites: Must be a mana-using class or have innate mana due to race or class, not from an item.
Enclave.Ethos: The Enclave was created to act as a voice for the needs of Wizards and their lesser brethren, and to gain power, respect and influence for all mana users.
Enclave.Restrictions: As the Enclave seeks to curry favour with the Imperium, Outlawed characters may join only on a guild special. Nobody who is outlawed for party killing may join or remain a member of the Enclave without the direct permission of the guild master.

Basic.Effect: after 10 seconds meditative thought an Enclave member may confirm or deny a question regarding magical issues, as magical Minor Prayer

Basic.Name: Library Study
Basic.Effect: after 30 seconds meditative thought a Enclave member may remember an important piece of information, relevant to magical matters only, as magical Major Prayer.

Basic.Effect: Gains the ability to Recognise Mana and Read Mana Glyphs (not use scrolls), If these skills are already both owned then may choose to be well equipped with any one standard scroll

Hell Company.PreRequisites: All members of Hell Company must be goodly aligned.
Hell Company.Ethos: Hell Company was formed to combat the minions of the Lords of Hell. Whenever Demonkind are summoned or sent into the exostance they are to be driven back to the hells. This is not to say that if a Demon is seeking redemption that they should not be helped but… they rarely are…
Hell Company.Restrictions: Members of Hell Company must be willing to fight the denizens of the hells wherever they raise their heads. If a member leaves an adventure where any evil Demonkind that they are aware of and were able to affect remain alive, and not on their own plane, then the member gains no points or levels for the adventure. This does not apply if the Demon has fled beyond reach.

Basic.Effect: This grants +1 MAC and +1 SAC versus attacks from Demons.

Basic.Effect: may call forth ‘holy fire' to cover any one normal weapon, whatever it may be. Whilst wielded by a goodly target it inflict s +0 light-based white mana damage for the next 5 minutes versus Demons only with the verbal “Powers of light imbue this weapon of vengeance with thy strength, to spell the downfall of Demonkind”.

Intermediate.Effect: User can see through magical and spiritual darkness for 5 minutes, with the verbal “I call upon the powers of light and truth, let me walk unhindered through midnight's shadow”.

Intermediate.Name: Empowered defence
Intermediate.Effect: This grants +1 MAC and +1 SAC versus red / black mana, and against evil spirits, as well as against attacks from Demonkind.

Intermediate.Name: Discern Demonkind
Intermediate.Effect: 20' Y/N mantic info effect.

Intermediate.Name: Enhanced Discern Demonkind
Intermediate.Effect: 1/day 20' Y/N mantic info effect that reveals the demonic racial name [or approx imately if a unique creature] and up to 3 useful words describing the creatures power s of an identified Demonkind . E.g. Shadow Demon – assassin fears light.

Advanced.Name: Heavens Shield
Advanced.Effect: 36 point mantic `Shield against the Dark` vs attacks from Demons.

Advanced.Name: Hand of Truth
Advanced.Effect: Hand of purity vs Demonkind. Death from casting is not permanent.

In Purity.PreRequisites: Membership is open to those who believe Primus is for the living, not the Undead!! Those capable of summoning Undead and, of course, Undead themselves are unwelcome.
In Purity.Ethos: The Guild is here to gather a group of individuals that share a common interest and will work together to achieve their aim.
In Purity.Restrictions: Membership is open to those who believe Primus is for the living, not the Undead!! Those capable of summoning Undead and, of course, Undead themselves are unwelcome.

Basic.Name: Know your Foe
Basic.Effect: Discern nature of Undead (as priestly discern). If this is already owned they gain a single use of a “know your foe” (as privileged ability) but only vs Undead.

Basic.Name: Blessing of purity 1/day
Basic.Effect: Takes a 30 second prayer and works on either a living goodly individual (including self) or a dead body (of any alignment) and grants a fortified spirit as tables except the individual cannot choose to be raised as Undead even if they wish. If used on the living this lasts until the end of the dungeon. If used on a dead body it lasts until they are restored to life. Immunity to slayer may be applied by an unwilling dead body.

Basic.Name: “Purity”
Basic.Effect: Holy Word 60ft radius halt Undead (as the miracle).

Intermediate.Name: Lifes cry
Intermediate.Effect: War Cry but works against all undead touch effects, gaining immunity to all of them for 5 minutes

Intermediate.Effect: Covers one weapon in a dose of holy water vs Undead for the next blow, does not need to be the users weapon.

i: Covers one weapon in a dose of holy water vs Undead for the next blow, does not need to be the users weapon.

Knights of Legend.PreRequisites: Be a Knight of the Land. To claim the Advance Tier a member must either complete an adventure in The Land of Legend or be invited by The Lord Knight. Membership of this guild needs to be signed onto the character card by the current Lord Knight, or Robert as Lord of Legend (if you complete an adventure in The Land of Legend please see Martin Witts – forum name Mart07 who plays Robert to have your membership signed on).
Knights of Legend.Ethos: This organisation is a guild formed within the Land of Legend for those Knights that support the ideals of the Knights in action, word and deed. It is expected that its members attend Knight of the Land gatherings whenever possible. The power of the guild stems from the ancient Banner of the Land, Resolution – Its power is now unfettered and is able to influence those Knights that have travelled with him over any distance.

Basic.Name: Inspiration
Basic.Effect: Seek Inspiration as per a Lucky Idea. This takes 10 seconds to activate.

Basic.Name: ‘For the Land'
Basic.Effect: Determination (taking 6 TBLP from any stopping effect suffered but not the stopping effect)

Intermediate.Name: Chosen of Imrazil
Intermediate.Effect: Chosen of the Faithful [+2 DAC], but will affect any Knight of Legend, including elves etc. The DAC from this watching will not stack with any other chosen/watching/blessing. If this ability or similar blessing is already possessed then this ability instead grants +1 DAC, stacking with other KOTL guilds but no other.

Intermediate.Name: ‘For the Land'
Intermediate.Effect:
Choose one on use: 
i: Determination (taking 6 TBLP from any stopping effect suffered but not the stopping effect)
ii: Mobility, if used in this way costs 12tblp per use.

Intermediate.Name: Resistance to Avenging Spirit
Intermediate.Effect: As per the tables resistance – should this already be possessed it can used to grant Immunity to Dying Effects 1/day as per the tables resistance.

Advanced.Name: ‘For the Land'
Advanced.Effect:
Choose one on use: 
i: Determination (taking 6 TBLP from any stopping effect suffered but not the stopping effect)
ii: Mobility, if used in this way costs 12tblp per use.
 iii: Resist listed Domination effects, however user suffers 18tblp per use

Advanced.Name: Resolute
Advanced.Effect: Grants +1 level of resistance to all effects

Knights of the Risen Phoenix.PreRequisites: Members of the Knights of the Risen Phoenix may not attack peons and other weak or defenseless creatures except in defense of self or the party and will actively seek to protect non-aggressive peons/defenseless creatures against the un-warranted aggressive actions of others, including those of the party.
Knights of the Risen Phoenix.Ethos: The order follows the Mother Phoenix, a kind and nurturing creature who seeks to protect the weak and bring peace to the world. Our order judges people by their actions, not by the colour of their soul. The light-hearted fascist who smites the helpless due to the colour of their soul and the dark-hearted bringer of chaos who revels in destruction are both to be equally thwarted. We seek to protect, through strength of arms, intelligence and guile, those who do not have the ability to protect themselves and to try and bring peace and harmony where we tread.
Knights of the Risen Phoenix.Restrictions: Members of the Knights of the Risen Phoenix may not attack peons and other weak or defenseless creatures except in defense of self or the party and will actively seek to protect non-aggressive peons/defenseless creatures against the un-warranted aggressive actions of others, including those of the party.

Basic.Name: Life of the phoenix
Basic.Effect: With 30 seconds meditation benefits as per a regeneration Elixir on self, but is not a flesh and blood effect, rather mantic (Gold/Red/Good spirit).

Basic.Name: Fires of the Phoenix
Basic.Effect: Mantic (Red/Goodly) fire blade, Knights of the risen Phoenix that are not evil gain utilise good spirit item for this.

Basic.Effect: 1st time a day needed gains live to minus 6 TBLP that cannot be inflicted by fire and while in this live to minus regens 1/1 to the most injured location per 30 seconds, or until out of the live to.

Choose one:

iii: Mantic Life Overwhelms (as Jade spell) but is red/gold/good spirit in nature. Verbal: `The Phoenix overwhelms!`

Advanced.Name: Fire of the phoenix

Choose one:

ii: Mantic Talk to Salamander
iii: Mantic sword of power (gaining utilise goodly spirit item for this ability). 
If unused then upon death can be triggered acting as a Mantic (flaming) Avenging spirit on the Knights of the risen Phoenix members' slayer.

1st time a day needed gains live to minus 6 TBLP that cannot be inflicted by fire and while in this live to minus regens 1/1 to the most injured location per 30 seconds, or until out of the live to. 
If the user already has table 3 Immunity to Fire then when used it grants either:

ii: Resilience (as per Pasha status) equal to the users table vs fire.

Obsidian Cabal.PreRequisites: All members must be evil or have guild heads permission to join.
Obsidian Cabal.Ethos: The Obsidian Cabal are a collection of dark hearted mercenaries who put politics aside to get the less than pleasant jobs done. The Cabal know that through working together they can achieve more than those who let morals weigh them down.
Obsidian Cabal.Restrictions: Any guild member who kills another member of the Cabal is kicked out. This can be over ridden by the guild head.

Basic.Name: Kin with Obsidian Cabal members on dungeon
Heart of Evil
Basic.Effect:
Members cannot be forced to attack Obsidian Cabal members, e.g. spiritually mastered with orders to kill someone. Additionally when raging they are able to identify fellow Obsidian Cabal members and do not have to attack them. None of this means they can't attack them, just they don't have to.
 If Obsidian Cabal members have a restriction that would require them to attack other members it does not apply ( e.g. a Silverfolk and a non -silverfolk neuronicist).

Intermediate.Name: Kin with other Obsidian Cabal members on dungeon
Intermediate.Effect: True Kin with other Obsidian Cabal members on dungeon

Intermediate.Name: Draw on the Inner Evil
Intermediate.Effect:
Acts as a True Believer for any Evil religion, but can only be used for evil miracles.
Alternatively it may be used to cast a standard Black or Onyx spell with 30 seconds prep.

Intermediate.Name: Strength of Evil
Intermediate.Effect: Gains +3/1 life if on dungeon with another Obsidian Cabal member.

Advanced.Name: Strength of Evil
Advanced.Effect: Gains +3/1 per other Obsidian Cabal member on dungeon, to a max of +9/3.

Of the North.Background:
Men, dwarves, their friends and allies gather around hearth and home in the Breakan mountains to the north of the Empire of Glass. The mountains are both a harsh and unforgiving place that borders on the edge of the world between the lands beyond the rainbow bridge to the far north and Empire to the south. It breeds its people strong and tough. Weathered to most kinds of adversity and able to adapt to anything that is unknown.
Almost tribal in nature are the bonds that draw the hearths and homes together. An enemy here is one not to be ignored. Deal with it yourself, draw your friends and allies to your side and wait not for betrayal and poison in your ale, your gold to be stolen or a knife in your back!
We may ally with the Empire and others as a need arises but we will not be beholden to anyone.
Of the North.PreRequisites: Anyone with a position of power within the Empire (e.g. a Title) or anyone seeking to bring the North under the Empire’s control may not join.
Of the North.Ethos: To remain free of the bonds of Empire or of any other that may seek to tame the wilds of the Far North and its people
Of the North.Restrictions:
No kind of non violence pact between the ‘men’ of the North will ever be put in place. The place is wild and so are its people, sometimes they will disagree!

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS: Anyone with a position of power within the Empire (e.g. a Title) or anyone seeking to bring the North under the Empire’s control may not join.

Basic.Name: Hardened upbringing
Basic.Effect: Gains live to minus 6 first time each day it is needed.

Basic.Name: Touched by the Cor Sam
Basic.Effect: ½ effect natural cold.

Basic.Name: The Tales of the North
Basic.Effect: Acts as a seven word lucky idea about beasts/mystical foes, be they giants, dragons, giant snakes etc.

Intermediate.Name: Touched by the Cor Sam
Intermediate.Effect: Immunity to Cold

Intermediate.Name: Hardened upbringing
Intermediate.Effect: live to minus 6 at all times, and the first time it is needed each day all live to minus owned is doubled.

Intermediate.Name: The Wild lands

Advanced.Effect: Immunity to all cold

Advanced.Name: Brutal Childhood
Advanced.Effect: 1st time a day it is needed all live to minus also applies to locations, increasing the amount of damage they need to suffer to be severed.

Sakura.PreRequisites: Any Amlesian who supports the Jade Emperor may join. This includes those of the clans, tribes, Fortunes, Kami etc.
Sakura.Ethos: Members should be seeking to encourage their clans/tribes or others to join the Accord/treaty and ensure the stability of the treaty under the guidance and advice of the Kotei.
Sakura.Restrictions: Action against the emperor or outlawing results in immediate expulsion from guild and you cannot re-join unless you have cleared your honour by Seppuku or with the Kotei

Basic.Name: Loyalty to the Jade Emperor
Basic.Effect: If the individual does not have a status within the Jade Empire (EG is a Thun) then membership of the guild means most people Loyal to the Empire will treat them with civility and courtesy.

Basic.Name: Honour the Dragon
Basic.Effect:
At the start of the day can chose to gain + 2 MAC vs one Elemental colour of magic, but – 1 vs the opposite colour. If Grey is chosen only 1 MAC is gained, but no mac is lost vs other colours.
Thanks to the Dragons (7th-13th December) this doubles.

Basic.Name: I will honour the Code
Basic.Effect: Discipline

Intermediate.Name: Blessing of the Fates
Intermediate.Effect:
At the start of the day can choose to be blessed by Amlalt and gain + 2 SAC vs Evil, or Avral and gain + 2 SAC vs Good, or they may choose the Twins as a whole and gain + 1 SAC vs all alignments.
Thanks to the Fates (24th-30th September) this doubles.

Intermediate.Name: Call to the Dragons
Intermediate.Effect: 30 seconds prep can cast a handbook spell of the same colour as the Dragon chosen for Honour the dragons.

Intermediate.Name: I will honour the code
Intermediate.Effect: Discipline and a War Cry (used at the same time)

Advanced.Name: I will honour the code
Advanced.Effect: Discipline, War cry and Mobility, but applies vs all powerbases.

Advanced.Name: Honour of the dead
Advanced.Effect: Gains fated hero as tables, if owned then gains undecided destiny. Three days either side of the Birth of the Celestial Emperor (7th October) a member may instead choose to gain the Celestial Emperors blessing which means their first dea th of the day will cost 5% less res chance (if ressed on dungeon) providing the resurrection is begun within 15 minutes of death.

Advanced.Name: Blessing be upon the Jade Emperor
Advanced.Effect: live to minus 6 that also applies to crits. This live to minus is magical or spirit chosen at the battleboard. Thanks to the Emperors (1st-7th January) the live minus is Mantic.

The White Lotus Society.PreRequisites: Any who hold Loyalty to the Jade Emperor or his Empire, and are willing to sacrifice their lives to protect them (does not need to be Oriental).
The White Lotus Society.Ethos: In service to the Jade Emperor, The White Lotus Society will dedicate ourselves to two causes, first and foremost, our loyalty to the Jade Emperor and his Empire; we will protect these with our lives, without question. Second is the improvement of relations with our Empire and all others in this world we share.
The White Lotus Society.Restrictions: Guild members must be loyal to the Jade Emperor or his Empire; should a member show extreme disloyalty to either of these things they are instantly removed from the guild and may only rejoin the guild should an adequate show of loyalty be given. This will be judged by either the guild master or the Jade Emperor. No member of The White Lotus Society will leave another behind on a mission; should this occur no points for the day will be gained.

Basic.Name: Unity of the Empire
Basic.Effect: with the guild masters permission gains “Hanger On” to any one Amlesian Clan for the duration of a dungeon, allowing them to count as a member of the guild for calculating guild numbers.

Basic.Name: Song for the dead
Basic.Effect: If spends the ritual time for a resurrection in silent prayer then the person being restored to life returns fully healed, rather than having to wait for 5 minutes. Does not need to be the one casting the resurrection, just “participating”.

Basic.Name: Petals of Life
Basic.Effect: Gains live to minus 1 per member of the guild on dungeon

Basic.Name: Heart of the Lotus
Basic.Effect: +3/1 guild life

Basic.Name: Will of the Empire
Basic.Effect: Retroactive, grants +1 level of resistance; does not stack with levels of resistance gained from other guild benefits.

Intermediate.Name: Song for the dead
Intermediate.Effect:
Choose one:
i: If spends the ritual time for a resurrection in silent prayer then the person being restored to life returns fully healed, rather than having to wait for 5 minutes. Does not need to be the one casting the resurrection, just “participating”
ii: Remove a slayer effect and/or the taint of undeath from the person being returned to life.

Intermediate.Name: Petals of Life
Intermediate.Effect: will always grant a minimum of 6 points of live to minus, and now grants 2 points of live to minus per White Lotus member.

Intermediate.Name: To defend with honour
Intermediate.Effect: If a fellow Amlesian or White Lotus member has been incapacitated/rendered helpless this innate may be used granting +12/4 temp life and one of (chosen when the innate is used): A War Cry, a discipline or a cold rage. The benefits last for 5 minutes and if the innate is not used it is lost.

Intermediate.Name: Educated individual
Intermediate.Effect: Gains Read Languages for Arcadd, if already owned gains a major prayer about Arcadd, poetry, or relevant Amlesian writings.

Choose one:
i: If spends the ritual time for a resurrection in silent prayer then the person being restored to life returns fully healed, rather than having to wait for 5 minutes. Does not need to be the one casting the resurrection, just “participating”
ii: Remove a slayer effect and/or the taint of undeath from the person being returned to life
iii:  can instead be used to reduce the ritual prep of the restore life to 1 minute, but the individual being restored to life will not gain the benefits a total heal until after resting for 5 minutes.

Advanced.Name: Petals of Life
Advanced.Effect: will always grant a minimum of 6 points of live to minus, and now grants 2 points of live to minus per White Lotus member and live to minus applies to locations

Advanced.Name: The Fates decide
Advanced.Effect: is immune to any random acts of misfortune or similar. This could include “one person in the party is randomly ritual struck ” - it would never be a White Lotus member unless there are only White Lotus members present. This is refs discretion and the spirit should be followed. This also grants fated hero, and if already owned undecided destiny.

Advanced.Name: Will of the Empire
Advanced.Effect: Applies all day: Retroactive, grants +1 level of resistance; does not stack with levels of resistance gained from other guild benefits.

Advanced.Name: To Defend with honour
Advanced.Effect: +12/4 temp life and one of (chosen when the innate is used): A War Cry, a discipline or a cold rage. The benefits last for 5 minutes and if the innate is not used it is lost.

Totemic Guardians.Ethos: We stand together to answer the call of the tribes and totems of the lands. Holding moots and tribal gatherings throughout the wilds the Totemic Guardians seek to gather tribal heroes together so we can aid and strengthen our tribes and clans....UG!!! Muttley, Grand High Shamanic Magi of Thunder and Storms (who many thought was dead) has a spirit link to all guild members and can summon dead bodies. As such individuals are free to inform him OOC of their death and he can decide if they are worthy of being saved or left to rot like a goblin.
Totemic Guardians.Restrictions:
If asked must always lend aid in any form or help other tribals, unless you’re fighting against them...then kill them and eat them!! Any guild member who attacks and kills a fellow tribal guild member will be cast out of the guild

The Totemic guardians understand that your tribe always comes first, but you must always seek to aid and stand by your fellow Guild members. Outlaws must ask permission from guild heads before joining.

Basic.Name: A Tribe's a Tribe
Basic.Effect:
If a Totemic Guardians' Shaman is not on dungeon may choose to give another Shaman that is present spirits as if a member of their tribe.
 If a guild members own Witchdoctor is not on dungeon may choose to give another Witchdoctor that is present mana as if a member of their tribe.

Basic.Name: Tribal Influence
Basic.Effect: When a Shaman or Witch Doctor casts a published Miracle or Spell that normally effects their own tribe it may instead be cast to benefit their own tribe and all members of the Totemic Guardians, with all members of the Totemic Guardians counting towards its effect.

Basic.Name: Totems Watching
Basic.Effect: Choose a Primal Soul Predator/Prey minor talent (as per Primal Soul choice sets).

Basic.Name: +1 Strength
Basic.Effect: not for combat purposes

Intermediate.Name: +1 Strength
Intermediate.Effect: Stacking to +2 max

Intermediate.Name: Totems Watching
Intermediate.Effect: Choose a Primal Soul Predator/Prey medium talent (as per Primal Soul choice sets).

Advanced.Name: Strength of the Totems
Advanced.Effect: Physical mark of the totems, but with all members of Totemic Guardians counting as members of the tribe for the benefits. Requires 30 seconds “Bigging Up” the person getting it.

Advanced.Name: Not going down
Advanced.Effect: If a member of the Totemic Guardians is killed can choose to gain the benefits of a stand and die vs the person that killed them.

Wahadamune.PreRequisites: Any Ishmaic Human that is loyal to the confederacy may join. Non-human Ishmaics require the guild masters permission to join.
Wahadamune.Ethos:
Wahadamune is a political guild for all Ishmaics. The outlook of Wahadamune is one of unity, it’s members seek to defend the clans and people of Ishma, and the larger world as a whole.

Wahadamune is a collective, peoples from all clans come to join and remain members of their mother clan upon joining. Wahadamune also allows membership of any Ishmaic race, so long as they abide by the restrictions. Long have the roaming people of the Ishmaic Confederacy been separate, banded into smaller tribes. Strong family but weaker as individuals. A new power has risen, grown over years uniting those of the confederacy under a single banner, promoting unity against the threats that the world holds against their lands and people; the whole making up more than the sum of their parts
Wahadamune.Restrictions:
Wahadamune is a collective from all clans, you may be a member of Wahadamune and your original clan chosen at creation, or just Wahadamune.

Must be Ishmaic to join, you may not join if you are Outlawed or Ostracised within Ishma (however those Outlawed or Ostracised by the Imperial Seers rather than Rainfinders may appeal this decision to the Guild Head). Becoming Outlawed or Orstracised in Ishma may cause you to be cast out, potentially immediately at ref discretion if the crime should be severe enough.

Basic.Name: Invoke the Winds Protection
Basic.Effect: Grants the user the next level of the “Winds”. If the 1st Wind is owned then this grants immunity to magic for 5 minutes.

Overrides.Effect: Usable if a fellow member of the Ishmaic Confederacy is unconscious, incapacitated, or killed by a foe. Gains +6/2 life for 5 minutes, even if the individual recovers.
Usable if a fellow member of the Ishmaic Confederacy is unconscious, incapacitated, or killed by a foe. Gains an innate War Cry for 5 minutes, even if the individual recovers.

Basic.Name: Aid of the Clan
Basic.Effect:
At the start of the day can choose to gain the aid of one of the Ishmaic Clans as follows: 
o Galahbhad – Armour is tinkered by the clans armourers, granting immunity to accuracy.
o Buladajn – Venoms Whisper Gains Immunity to poison for 5 minutes. 
o Benhai – Gains an innate Jump that also grants the benefits of Trap wary 
o Salahmen – 1/day gains double level of resistance vs magic for 5 minutes 
o Harazaen – Consume the Curse 1/day – Grants immunity to one Curse, must be used within 2 seconds of the curse being suffered 
o Rain – Draw on the winds 1/day Takes 30 seconds prep and can act as a standard Elemental spell up to 4th level.

Intermediate.Name: Aid of the Clan
Intermediate.Effect: Gains a second choice from Aid of the Clan.

Intermediate.Name: Discern Enemy of the Confederacy
Intermediate.Effect: 20ft range physical/magical info FX that discerns if a member is an enemy of the Confederacy and a 3 word reason why.

Intermediate.Name: Legend of the Sands
Intermediate.Effect: Grants stacking Live to Minus 6 the first time it is needed. Whilst in this LTM, gains Recuperate and can trigger One Last Effort (both as the Survivor multiclass).

Yeomen of the Empire.PreRequisites: To be a Yeoman as listed in Realm of Glass and to have purchased at least 1 rank of abilities. Pre 8th level Yeomen may join but do not gain benefits until the first status has been purchased.
Yeomen of the Empire.Ethos: The Yeomen of the Empire are the defenders and protectors of Primus. They fight for the greater good of peace within the land, and many a time a lone Yeoman has stood as the last line of defence, falling so that others may live. They are the protectors of the Nobility and will fight for their causes as well as protecting the Land that those Nobles own. This order rose with the Republic, only to fall away at the hands of the Magiarchs. They then rallied to Amora’s call, only to again melt away with the emergence of the Mercenary Caste. Now their Land needs them again… Who will answer the call?
Yeomen of the Empire.Restrictions:
Any Member who is outlawed ceases to be a member of this guild from the moment they are outlawed. They may re enter upon being cleared of any charges with the permission of the Guild Head or his deputy.

A Yeoman must always think of Primus first. Peons are to be helped, not looked on as an inconvenience and members have purest self-defence restrictions against Peons.

The Nobility should be respected and protected as well as the common folk of the Land. It is, after all, those Nobles whose blood is linked to the Land.

Referees should be MOST harsh on any member of this guild who openly encourages attacks on, or is dismissive of, the folk of Primus.

Basic.Name: Kin
Basic.Effect: to all other Yeoman on dungeon.

Basic.Name: Strength of the yeoman
Basic.Effect: Gain +3/1 life per yeoman on dungeon, to a max of +6/2.

Basic.Name: Memories of the Yeoman
Basic.Effect: With 30 seconds concentration acts as a major prayer about matters previous Yeoman may have known. This includes rituals, ancient foes, lost treasures etc. It should be a broad interpretation of what can be covered, but it could be slightly cryptic or incomplete.

Intermediate.Name: Aid of the Clan
Intermediate.Effect: Gains a second choice from Aid of the Clan.

Intermediate.Name: Discern Enemy of the Confederacy
Intermediate.Effect: 20ft range physical/magical info FX that discerns if a member is an enemy of the Confederacy and a 3 word reason why.

Intermediate.Name: Legend of the Sands
Intermediate.Effect: Grants stacking Live to Minus 6 the first time it is needed. Whilst in this LTM, gains Recuperate and can trigger One Last Effort (both as the Survivor multiclass).

Church of Certizal, Shadow of the First.Ethos: The guild follows the Shadow of the First Evil, a powerful Demon of Corruption ascended to Divine Power by the actions of his chosen one Lomo, and others. The duty of the church is to foster Evil in the hearts of men. It is more powerful to cause another to carry out an act of evil than do it yourself. Working from the shadows until a place is claimed the Church seek to spread across the Empire and beyond.
Church of Certizal, Shadow of the First.Restrictions: The Guild is a full black guild (as per WFA rules). If a member ever ceases to be Evil they are instantly Excommunicated. Note - If slain a member of the church, or a character with Pact to Certizal, claiming Kallah benefits linked to Certizal or if they are Demon Touched by Certizal, can choose to Word of Recall to Lomo who can cast a Mantic (Ebony/Evil Spirit) Command Life on the individual. This costs 20% (10% if fated hero is owned). For reference: Command Life is as animate life except the individual does not become Undead. Instead they discern as spiritually mastered, and if removed they die. It does not function on those immune to spiritual mastery. This should be written on the individuals card.

Overrides.Effect: Grants immunity to one evil spiritual effect; used as warcry, cannot benefit from Goodly spirits for the duration.

Basic.Name: Shroud of Evil
Basic.Effect: Grants immunity to goodly spirits for 30 seconds

Basic.Name: Words of Certizal
Basic.Effect: Upgrades a `conceal lie` miracle so it grants spiritual Deception at will for 5 minutes

Intermediate.Name: Embraced by Evil
Intermediate.Effect: Grants immunity to all evil spiritual effects; used as warcry, can't benefit from Goodly spirits for 30 seconds.

Intermediate.Name: Shroud of Evil
Intermediate.Effect: Grants immunity to goodly spirits for 30 seconds, can be used as retroactive against 1 effect

Intermediate.Name: Feed on Evil
Intermediate.Effect: +1 Spirit per evil member of the party

Advanced.Effect: Grants immunity to goodly spirits for 5 minutes or against 1 effect if used retroactively

Advanced.Name: Shroud of Evil
Advanced.Effect: Grants immunity to all evil spiritual effects for five minutes; can be retroactive

Church of Certizal, Shadow of the First.DenominationalMiracleNote: This miracle may be learnt as normal by priests of Certizal post 8th.

Church of Dead Heroes.PreRequisites: Priests or Lay Believers of Dead Heroes may be any alignment. Outlaws may not join without the high priest’s permission, and members who are Outlawed may not remain without his permission. No member of the church may act against the Empire of Glass as it is the current belief of the Church that this Empire is essential and central to existence. All members must be from Primus and people from outside the Empire may only join with permission of the High Priest. People belonging to other churches or who worship other deities may not join.
Church of Dead Heroes.Ethos: In our past hundreds and thousands have died defending both the Empire and Primus from threats and conflict. Some have died willingly, many of the vitae infused heroes, and others less willingly, the soldiers of the armies of the Empire. As such these people, these Heroes, responsible for our existence today should be remembered and their names and stories passed from generation to generation. However we should remember that one man’s hero may be another’s villain. While we venerate Heroes and remember them, they are not our gods. It may be required for us to stand against them, and even kill them. The faith’s duty is in inspiring – remembering the deeds of a Hero and inspiring others with it, not bending knee to them. Kurten D’treal has spirit link to all dead guild members, and can choose to Word of Recall them to him. As such members are free to inform him OOC of their death and he can choose to rescue them, or leave them to ascend to being a Dead Hero as he wishes.

Basic.Name: Personal Faith
Basic.Effect: Each Priest of the Dead Heroes has a Personal Faith, and may design their own miracle list following the rules for a Hermit Priest. The Priest uses the miracle list even if not battle-boarding the Church's basic benefits.

Basic.Name: Call on Heroes Past [Beginning]
Basic.Effect: After 30 seconds appropriate prayer may cast any one handbook miracle of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil) of up to 4th level.

Intermediate.Name: Enlightened
Intermediate.Effect: Gains free 8th level miracle on Miracle list as per Hermit Priest.

Intermediate.Name: Call on Heroes Past [Middle]
Intermediate.Effect: After 60 seconds of appropriate prayer may cast any one handbook miracle of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil) of up to 6th level.

Intermediate.Name: Allied Hero
Intermediate.Effect: One Undead summoned by the Priest will be helpful and act in a friendly or respectful manner towards the Priest and their allies.

Intermediate.Name: Knowledgeable Guidance
Intermediate.Effect: One Comm I will yield 1 word answers, not just Yes / No answers.

Intermediate.Name: Reviving Strength
Intermediate.Effect: One Handbook healing tree miracle cast upon a Member of the Church grants +25% effect

Intermediate.Name: Stalwart Warding
Intermediate.Effect: May cast a Handbook Warding Miracle as to allow any member of the church to be able to cross freely.

Intermediate.Name: Aggressive Champion
Intermediate.Effect: If casting a Handbook Force Tree miracle within 30 seconds of a previous casting the spirit cost of the miracle is reduced by 1 (non -cumulative with itself or other spirit cost reductions). Minimum 1 spirit.

Intermediate.Name: Willing spirits of Carnage
Intermediate.Effect: If a handbook Causing tree miracle is not discharged after being cast the priest regains ½ the spirits round ed down minimum of 1. This has no effect on miracles cast using innates, scrolls or items.

Intermediate.Name: Ancestral Aid
Intermediate.Effect: A Bless or Beneficial Curse may be cast on any Church Member and will benefit them regardless of their alignment so long as they adhere to the tenets of the faith.

Intermediate.Name: Peaceful Departure
Intermediate.Effect: One Undead dismissed leaves no taint on the body (as it had been purified).

Advanced.Name: Aid of Heroes Past
Advanced.Effect: The Intermediate Tier innate chosen above is now upgraded to ‘at will', provided that the Priest has purchased the relevant Major Sphere

Advanced.Name: Embody Milo
Advanced.Effect: Grants full Undead immunities for 5 minutes. However for the duration the Priest's left arm ceases to exist for any purpose as if it had been cut off (no damage is taken for this and no other disadvantages associated with losing a limb, such as a dwarf dying, are suffered). This means that whilst embodied miracles / abilities that require both hands to be able to cast / activate cannot be used.

Advanced.Name: Call on Heroes Past [End]
Advanced.Effect: After 2 minutes appropriate prayer may cast any one handbook miracle of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil) of up to 8th level, if not on own miracle list then this costs tblp/spirits as normal.

Church of the Empress Goddess.PreRequisites: Open to any Goodly priest. Only Goodly individuals may join without the permission of the High Priest or 2 Custodians
Church of the Empress Goddess.Ethos:
Members of this Church worship Truic Amora-Badrass, the Grand Duchess of Halgar, Empress of Labyrinthia and Realm Spirit of Glass as a Goddess in her own right. They recognise the fact that the current Empress has become the first Master or Mistress of Primus to truly master the Nagrech. Furthermore, members of this faith venerate the choice that the Empress made in sacrificing her own humanity and mortality to ascend to the position of Realm Spirit of Glass in order to combat the rise of The Spiter in the Sunless Lands. This act is held up as an example of the devotion to the duty of protecting the Empire, its borders and the people who reside within it that all members of the church should aspire to. This church is a goodly faith and represents the Empresses’ moral outlook as a goodly, constructive and peace loving being – violence should genuinely not be the first option. However, it is clearly not pacifistic in that its members are free (and often encouraged) to resort to martial means if necessary in the protection of the Empire and its people or in order to uphold Imperial Law. This faith is currently most commonly followed by those outside the mercenary community, though its influence there is starting to grow. It is also particularly popular within some of the most fervent of the legions within the Bastion.

MIRACLE LIST 1st Halt (N) Dismiss Zombie (G) 2nd Halt Undead (G), Cure Serious (G) 3rd Protection from Spirits (N), Spirit Shield (N) Talk to Spirit, (N) Bless, (G) Dismiss Ghoul, (G) 4th Heal (G) 5th VoP (N) Spirit Invis (N) Dismiss Wraith (G) 6th Total Heal (G) Dismiss Vampire (G) 7th Pure Force (N)

Basic.Name: Fires of the Empress
Basic.Effect: May turn a standard offensive miracle mantic (red mana/flaming).

Basic.Name: Empresses Force
Basic.Effect:
May choose to benefit from one of the following:
i: Pure Force is now considered a Universal Sphere miracles, but costs a level to cast.
ii: Pure Force remains a Major force sphere miracle, but now only costs 6 spirits to cast.
iii: Gains an innate pure force.

Basic.Name: Mistress of the Throne
Basic.Effect: At the start of each day may add up to 10 spirits of standard miracles to the priest's miracle list. These may be changed dungeon to dungeon (or day to day on extended lengths). They CANNOT be used for making items/writing scrolls or similar.

Intermediate.Name: Mistress of the Throne
Intermediate.Effect: At the start of each day may add up to 10 spirits of published miracles to the priest's miracle list. These may be changed dungeon to dungeon (or day to day on extended lengths). They CANNOT be used for making items/writing scrolls or similar.

Intermediate.Name: Will of the Empress
Intermediate.Effect: One word minor prayer but the answer is from the broad opinion of the Empress (religiously).

Intermediate.Name: Force of Glass
Intermediate.Effect: One use of a pure force grants immunity to the effect for 10 seconds.

Advanced.Name: Will of the Empress
Advanced.Effect: Major prayer but the answer is from the broad opinion of the Empress (religiously)

Advanced.Name: Force of Glass
Advanced.Effect: One use of a pure force grants immunity to the effect for 30 seconds.

Advanced.Name: Fire of the Empress
Advanced.Effect: May turn a standard miracle mantic (red mana/flaming).

Advanced.Name: Strength of the Realm
Advanced.Effect: Members gain +1 Spirit per member of the Church or Noble of the Blood on dungeon (a person can only count once), to a maximum of their table. Non-spirit using classes (EG spirit warriors) may battle board these spirits as innates of miracles on their list.

Church of Knowledge.Ethos:
The Church of Knowledge places a high value on the pursuit of knowledge and understanding. It believes that knowledge is the key to personal growth, societal progress, and a deeper connection to the universe.
The Church of Knowledge does not require its worshippers to follow blind faith or dogma. Instead joining the church is an invitation to embark on a lifelong journey of learning, exploration, and self-discovery. It is a path to enlightenment through the power of knowledge and understanding.
The Church also encourages the study of a wide range of subjects, including history, philosophy, and art. It promotes the use of reason and logic in making decisions. Worshippers of the Church should be open to new discoveries and theories, even if they contradict existing beliefs.
Believers should encourage people to think for themselves and come to their own conclusions.
Embrace the Pursuit of Knowledge: Never stop seeking knowledge and understanding. Question everything, explore diverse perspectives, and engage with new ideas.
Value Critical Thinking: Approach all knowledge with a critical eye. Evaluate evidence, consider different interpretations, and challenge assumptions.
Share Knowledge Freely: Share most knowledge with others, fostering collaboration and collective enlightenment.
Forbidden Knowledge: Some knowledge is too dangerous to be shared freely. This should not be destroyed but instead should be kept safely and securely in case it is needed. No knowledge should be destroyed.

Basic.Name: Study of the book
Basic.Effect: At the start of the day gains an adventure temp Scripture of the Faith tied to the faith of Knowledge.  Before the dungeon these can be read by any member of the faith on dungeon.

Basic.Name: I give you my Knowledge
Basic.Effect: with 30 seconds prep time, can grant another priest (of any faith), knowledge of a miracle on the user's list.  Must be of an alignment the user can cast, but can break sphere restrictions (not devotion, however).  Lasts 5 minutes and after this time, the user loses knowledge of the miracle.

Basic.Name: I seek Knowledge and Understanding
Basic.Effect: acts as a knowledge of the arcane and then a single yes/no question around the inital answer.

Intermediate.Name: I give you my Knowledge
Intermediate.Effect: with 30 seconds prep time, can grant another priest (of any faith), knowledge of a miracle on the user's list.  Must be of an alignment the user can cast, but can break sphere restrictions (not devotion, however).  Lasts 15 minutes and during this time, the user loses knowledge of the miracle.

Intermediate.Name: Improved Spirit of seeing & hearing
Intermediate.Effect: With 30 seconds prep, Spirit of Seeing and Spirit of Seeing and Hearing now reveal the alignment of spirits present.

Intermediate.Name: Rec spirit reveals Y/N: living, undead, inanimate
Intermediate.Effect: Rec Spirit reveals if a spirit is living, undead, or inanimate (item, ward, scroll etc, doesn't reveal which of these it is)

Intermediate.Name: After casting Identify Spirit sucessfully on something, gains a follow up major prayer.
Intermediate.Effect: After casting Identify Spirit sucessfully on something, gains a follow up major prayer.

Advanced.Name: Study of the book
Advanced.Effect: Scruptures can be any faith but that faith must be chosen at the start of the day.

Advanced.Name: Improved Detect Spirits
Advanced.Effect:
With 30 seconds prep, Rec spirit and Milly's Detect Spirits now reveal the alignment of spirits present.
 with 30 seconds additional prep, Detect Spirits provides Guage Spirit details too (if guage spirit is owned)

Advanced.Name: Ask the correct God
Advanced.Effect: When casting a Comm sphere miracle that asks the spirits of Knowledge (eg Comm 2, Major Prayer etc) can choose to seek guidance from a specific patron (eg St Michael) and the answer should be shaped by this.

Church of Iron & Empire.PreRequisites: Be a Pro Empire, un-outlawed Evil Priest or be an Unholy Champion.
Church of Iron & Empire.Ethos:
In no way conventionally deific, this is an Imperial Church that typifies the dark, unyielding side of the Empire (but certainly does not see itself as being opposite or contrary to any other Imperial and Empress cults). It is an uncompromising faith that is preached here but offers simple answers to complex questions.
Unlike most churches Iron and Empire understands that the influence of the gods is bad for mortals, fanatic followers of goodly gods driven into battle by their lords and the bitter and twisted evil worshippers of the dark gods performing their foul tasks.
The church does not follow a Deity, although sometimes outsiders may view the church as worshipers of the Empress. The Church draws power from the dark hearts of the people, the belief in the nature of The Empire and from the Primal power of the Felldraken Isle.
Church of Iron & Empire.Restrictions:
• Should a member become Outlawed or Ostracised by the Empire they are automatically excommunicated until the matter is resolved. In game terms they cannot cast any miracle from the Church list, nor miracles learnt whilst a member. However this does not trigger Dedicated Power restrictions unless the individual refuses to hand themselves in for trial.
• Note: The Lord of Feldraken Isle can remove the High Priest from their role if they are not acting in the best interest of the Church, or simply fails to fulfil their duties.

Basic.Name: Gains Spiritual Discern Outlaw
Basic.Effect: Reveals individuals Ostracised by the Empire.

Basic.Name: Power of the Zombie
Basic.Effect: Counts as one level higher (stacks with published increases) for the purposes of Raising/Controlling Undead .

Basic.Name: Soul of Death
Basic.Effect: Gains a Fortified Spirit, and if raised as Undead by a member of the Iron and Empire the members body is not tainted, so can still be returned to life (or animated again).

Intermediate.Name: Strength of the Isle
Intermediate.Effect: When raising a published Undead they gain Depraved Cunning, Darkened Potence, Utilise strength with pure and Undead Alacrity. If the priest already has Depraved Cunning or Darkened Potence then the Undead instead gains an extra 5 Hits. The Undead summoned in this way is also controlled by the caster until they (the Undead) are slain (this included Vampires) .

Intermediate.Name: Loyalist's Feast
Intermediate.Effect: If using a Souls Hunger on an Outlaw, Wolfshead or individual ostracised by the Empire then the healing gained is doubled.

Intermediate.Name: Mastery of the Dead
Intermediate.Effect: When using Talk to Spirit on intelligent Undead the Undead cannot lie to it.

Intermediate.Name: Dark Feast Claimed
Intermediate.Effect: Can cast a Souls Hunger onto a causing miracle that is cast with Lesser Wings of darkness.

Advanced.Name: Purity in Death
Advanced.Effect: If raised as Undead then gains Depraved Cunning and retains own personality.

Advanced.Name: Threat to the Empire
Advanced.Effect: For 5 minutes vs one Target that is an Outlaw/Ostracised by the Empire all causing used by the priest inflict s permanent damage. Alternatively , the priest gains + 1 max damage (max quin) vs them. Chosen when used. Forged in Iron - Stage Two: Cost: +75 Table: 5

Church of the Lady of The Stars.Ethos:
The Lady of the Stars, is the Goddess of Light, Beauty and Joy, "those things that make life worth enjoying, not merely enduring". Historically, the church in Labyrinthia directed much of its energy towards the destruction of the Void God, but now that that end has been achieved, they have had a chance to step back and return the faith to its earlier roots. Since followers of the Lady of the Stars offer their whole-hearted love and devotion to the Lady, no individual who draws spiritual power from any other source or patron may claim membership of the Church of The Lady of the Stars. Any priest of the church who in some way acquires another spiritual patron must either reject that patron and their power *utterly*, or else leave the church (refusal to leave is an excommunicable offence). The only exception to this rule is followers of the other Valar, since the Lady is the representative of that pantheon upon this plane.

DARIG OF ELBERETH It is worth noting that Darig has a Spirit Link, as per the tables ability, with all Guild members. Miracle List

1st Halt, Cure Wound, Detect Spirit’s Nature, Power Meld, Spirit of Seeing 2nd Cure Serious 3rd Cure Disease, Talk to Spirits, Spirit Shield, Protection from Spirits, Bless, Dismiss Ghoul

4th Heal, Spirit Bolt 5th Dismiss Wraith, Voice of Power, Spiritual Invisibility 6th Total Heal, Dismiss Vampire 8th Restore Life

Intermediate.Name: Sight of the Stars
Intermediate.Effect: See Through Supernatural Darkness and Fully Active Spirit sight for 5 minutes. Verbal: “By her grace is darkness banished!”

Intermediate.Name: Looks Familiar
Intermediate.Effect: after 10 seconds of inspecting an Undead creature that responds as “unknown” can recall the name and level (as per Reveal Undead Name)

Advanced.Name: Immunity to Befriend Spirit and Spiritual Mastery

Church of Mortai.PreRequisites: Be a goodly weapons-wielding priest (not pure priest, hospitaller, armoured priest), or a paladin
Church of Mortai.Ethos:
Mortai is the brother god of Shaehan, and her defender. He strongly believes in the sanctity of life, and is the overseer of Undead across the planes. His role is to ensure that they do not stray outside the restrictions to which they are bound, by invading the dead bodies of mortals or otherwise seeking to take revenge on living spirits. His priests are expected to harm no living thing except where it is essential to defend a life, although those who raise Undead are an exception to this rule and may be acted against as the priest sees fit. Undead must be returned to their own plane, by force if necessary, and trapped mortal bodies freed from their corruption. Antagonistic daemonkind should also be destroyed or banished, as their spirits are also perversions of lost souls and they are drawn to harm the living.

MIRACLE LIST 1st Dismiss Zombie, Cure Wound 2nd Dismiss Skeleton, Halt Undead, Cure Serious Wounds 3rd Dismiss Ghoul, Protection from Spirits, Talk to Spirits, Spirit Shield, Cure Disease, Bless 4th Spirit Bolt, Heal, Dismiss Mummy 5th Spiritual Invisibility, Dismiss Wraith 6th Total Heal, Dismiss Vampire 7th Dismiss Level 7 Undead

Basic.Name: Guild Miracle
Basic.Effect: Reveal Undead Name added to own miracle list. If desired may instead battle -board this miracle as a 1/day innate.

Basic.Name: Sanctified Ground
Basic.Effect: may cast a Protection from Spirits [Evil] solely against Undead, in which case it does not require a line/circle to be drawn but is created around the caster in a radius of up to 6' or in a line up to 15' across up to 3' distance from the caster.

Basic.Name: The Enemy Predictable
Basic.Effect: Gains Combat Wary against Undead. The skill level is equal to the highest dismiss miracle known. [Max 10pts].

Intermediate.Name: Righteous Aura
Intermediate.Effect: The priest's spirit is concentrated more fully in opposition of Undead spirits. For the duration, the priest may not cast any miracle unless directly against Undead . However, any Undead creature of level 5 or below which touches or is touched by the priest is destroyed instantly, costing the priest 3 TBLP per level of the Undead . Undead of level 6 take 12 TBLP (4 hits) of goodly spiritual damage for each touch. This is a releasable miracle, and does affect the Undead.

Intermediate.Name: Sanctified Ground
Intermediate.Effect:
may cast a Protection from Spirits [Evil] solely against Undead, in which case it does not require a line/circle to be drawn but is created around the caster in a radius of up to 6' or in a line up to 15' across up to 3' distance from the caster.
May use a second innate of the Basic Tier ability or use it to act as per a n innate of ‘The Light of Faith', but with only a 15 minute duration.

Intermediate.Name: Fortified Spirit
Intermediate.Effect: as per the tables ability, If already possessed then gains Immunity to Slayer and similar effects.

Advanced.Name: The Shield of Mortai
Advanced.Effect: Spirit Shield but only against Undead Touch Effects, the user may choose whether to apply it or not against the attacks suffered. This innate only works on members of the Church of Mortai.

Advanced.Name: Stalwart Against Undeath
Advanced.Effect: Gains +18tblp casting stamina for the purposes of Dismissal Tree and Sphere miracles, Righteous Aura, and Hand of Purity.

Advanced.Name: Undead Sense
Advanced.Effect: As per the tables ability Spirit Sense but only applies against Undead. If Spirit Sense is already owned, then this ability is enhanced to grant Spiritual Vigilance against Undead.

Church of Shaehan.Ethos: Shaehan is the Goddess of Healing, Mercy and Charity. Shaehan priests will cure all who ask for it, though may ask those of evil alignment to repent before doing so. The priests have a similar outlook to Hospitallers but realise that fighting is a way of life and thus will not always try to stop a fight, although they will advise against it and will tidy up afterwards. They must never kill, or they will be instantly excommunicated by the goddess, unless it is against Undead or evil supernatural creatures which are antagonistic. Above all Shaehan priests believe in healing, mercy and the right of life regardless of alignment.
Church of Shaehan.Restrictions:
They must never kill, or they will be instantly excommunicated by the goddess (referee), unless it is against Undead or evil supernatural creatures which are antagonistic. May never manufacture anything supernatural except spiritual scrolls.

MESSAGE FROM THE HIGH PRIEST Faithful, please find me to receive the blessings of our lady, so that I can ensure that you are protected. The church and our Ladies power has much to provide. Keep safe whilst travelling the lands of Primus and beyond. And above all, embrace Her light wherever you walk. Miracle List

1st Cure Wound, Detect Spirit’s Nature, Halt 2nd Cure Serious Wounds 3rd Cure Disease, Talk to Spirit, Dismiss Ghoul, Protection from Spirits, Spirit Shield, Bless 4th Heal 5th Dismiss Wraith, Remove Fear and Paralysis, Spiritual Invisibility 6th Total Heal, Dismiss Vampire, Spiritual Freedom 8th Restore Life

Basic.Name: Discern Associated Spirits
Basic.Effect: If already possessed then gains Discern Nature of wounds to 20 feet.

Basic.Name: Extra Miracle
Basic.Effect: If battle boarding the Church as a Professional Guild gains the miracle Spirit Shift: As Words From Above but is a 4sp goodly miracle. Verbal: “Shaehan, Take me hence!”

Basic.Name: Haven
Basic.Effect: The Shaehan priest must audibly and clearly speak the Prayer of Haven immediately before meditating, the priest then speaks no further words before going into the meditative trance (Max. 3 seconds later). As the meditation starts the priest disappears from the point of meditation and appears at Shaehan's side where he/she is totally safe and gains +x1 meditation rate [max 5]. However the meditation ends after the pre -set time or when on full spirits which ever happens first, and cannot end before. The priest re -appears at the point where he/she started, unless the party have moved on in which case the priest will reappear at the safest place within 20' of the party.

Basic.Name: No place like Primus
Basic.Effect: Should any person within the party which the priest left call the name of the priest three times while they are in Haven, the priest becomes aware that they are being called and may elect to end the meditation early and return at that time. The meditation is not broken if they do not choose to do so. Oh Mistress Shaehan, Lady of Light Listen I plea to the prayer of Haven Oh Lady of Mercy Grant me sanctuary In which to meditate Protect and watch over me As I pray for the power To continue your work Shelter me under the wings Of the sacred dove Bathe me in your Holy Light Oh Lady Shaehan Goddess of Forgiveness and Mercy Let thy love shine over the lands Let me spread the word of your love As I preach your message of peace Grant me the power with which to heal And cure the wounds This mortal life doth caus e Show kindness to me thy priest And mercy to the persecuted Grant me thy servant The shelter of thy sacred abode I beseech thee Show your humble servant The tender mercies that this Mortal world doth lack Defend me from those who Would strike the defencel ess Protect me from those Who would show no mercy. NOTE: As Haven exists within the very essence of the goddess, entrance to it is barred to all except Priests of Shaehan. It is not possible to use means of interplanar transport to enter Haven.

Advanced.Name: Temple Altars
Advanced.Effect: The altars of the three main temples of Shaehan, in Scarlene, Sellville and the Halgar, are empowered to allow transport between them. A Shaehan member may spend 30 seconds in prayer before one, name one of the other two and touch the altar to be transported to it instantly. This may be done once per day from each altar for each Shaehan member, and may be repeated at will with the addition of casting the Spirit shift miracle after the prayer. This only transports guild members to one of the other two altars.

Advanced.Name: Passive Heal
Advanced.Effect: Member is aided by the Lady Shaehan such that they are considered to have a ‘Passive Heal' miracle active on them at all times. This means that should a Heal miracle be cast specifically into this ‘receptacle' it will be held in abeyance, and only activate on the priest should they be down more than 36 life, or have a location fall to zero or below. In all respects this functions like the Words from Above miracle, except that it has no duration, and may be replenished if desired whenever it is used. Defender of the Innocent - Stage Two: Cost: +90 Table: 7

Church of Saint Michael.Ethos:
Priests of Saint Michael follow the Creator of all things and on the whole try to reason with most problems; a guild for reasonable characters. However, many of the longer-standing members of the Church tend to interpret St Michael’s teachings in more ‘extreme’ ways, and this has led to some discussion about the possible division of the guild. The High Priest is at pains to point out, however, that the scriptures can be read in more than one way. Robert - It is worth noting that Robert, Cardinal of Saint Michael (Forum name - Mart07), has a Spirit Link, as per the tables ability, with all Guild members. Miracle List

1st Cure Wound, Detect Spirit’s Nature, Halt, Power Meld, Spirit of Seeing 2nd Cure Serious Wounds 3rd Cure Disease, Talk to Spirit, Dismiss Ghoul, Protection from Spirits, Spirit Shield, Bless 4th Heal, Spirit Bolt 5th Dismiss Wraith, Voice of Power, Spiritual Invisibility 6th Total Heal, Dismiss Vampire 8th Restore Life

Basic.Name: Stamina Blessing of St Michael
Basic.Effect: Gains +3/1 life from the blessing of St Michael.

Advanced.Name: Stamina Blessing of St Michael
Advanced.Effect: Gains +6/2 life from the blessing of St Michael.

Church of the Soul Forger.PreRequisites: Goodly Humans and Dwarven Priests. Other races may be accepted at the discretion of the High Priest on an individual basis.
Church of the Soul Forger.Ethos: The Soul forger forged the dwarven race from iron and mithril, and then breathed life into them as they cooled upon his forge. Priests of the Soul Forger are charged with upholding the dwarven virtues of law and light, and with guiding their people in the arts the dwarves hold dear. The dwarves have always revered the Master of the Forge, attempting to emulate his masterful work with metals and stone. Honesty and hard work pay off just as often in the mines and the forges, as they do on the battlefield, or so the dwarves claim. As such all priests of the Soul Forger are encouraged to spend at least some of their time at a forge learning and honing their skills.

Basic.Name: Bonds of the Soul
Basic.Effect: Gains +1 spirit (max 4) for every member of the Soul Forger church on dungeon (includes ley believers).

Basic.Name: The Master Forge provides
Basic.Effect: Members are well equipped with a suit of apprentice crafted armour, an apprentice crafted weapon, and an apprentice crafted shield – these are for themselves only.

Basic.Name: Blessings of the Forge
Basic.Effect: 1/day, enhances a normal bless in one of the following ways chosen when used: 1. To act as a Shield Blessing 2. To turn a normal suit of armour, shield or weapon apprentice crafted for the day. 3. To turn a normal weapon +0 goodly spirit for 5 mins 4. To enhance an object from “The Master Forge provides” to become journeyman status for the day.

Intermediate.Name: Bonds of the Soul
Intermediate.Effect: No longer limited to 4 spirits, and will always grant a minimum of 4 spirits.

Intermediate.Name: The Master Forge continues to provide
Intermediate.Effect: One of the objects from The Master Forge Provides (basic tier) is now journeyman status. If Blessing of the Forge is used on it then it becomes master status.

Intermediate.Name: Forges Light
Intermediate.Effect: Enhances a single casting of Passive Heal so that it lasts until triggered.

Advanced.Name: The Masters Forge
Advanced.Effect: Two of the objects gained are now journeyman status objects as intermediate tier. Alternatively can take a single object from the list as master status.

Advanced.Name: Blessings of the Forge
Advanced.Effect: If using Blessing of the Forge on a suit of armour it also grants that armour immunity to accuracy.

Advanced.Name: Forges Light
Advanced.Effect: The passive heal can now be set to only trigger when a Crit or TBLP reaches 0. This is chosen when cast.

The Rings of Talthar.PreRequisites: Be a goodly aligned priest or Paladin
The Rings of Talthar.Ethos:
Talthar is the Lord of Hope, a burning beacon of inspiration to his followers. Whilst the vast majority of Talthar's priests spend their time ministering to their congregations within the Church of Talthar works a dedicated core of worshipers; these are known as The Rings of Talthar. The Rings of Talthar are some of the most fervent worshipers of the Lord of Hope, those of the faith imbued with Vitae.

THE RINGS OF TALTHAR In some ways Talthar is a pantheon to itself in that it has seven aspects, represented by the seven interwoven rings that is its symbol. Whilst the most actively represented aspect in the mercenary community is that of Elbrime, Hope in adversity, there are others.
The Rings of Talthar.Restrictions:
Guild Members must choose to align themselves to one of the seven aspects of Talthar, which must be recorded on their character card. They may only battleboard the guild benefits of that ring. Miracle List

1st Cure Wound, Halt 2nd Cure Serious Wounds 3rd Cure Disease, Protection from Spirits, Talk to Spirits, Spirit Shield, Bless 4th Spirit Bolt, Heal 5th Voice of Power, Remove Voice of Power, Spiritual Invisibility 6th Total Heal, Dismiss Vampire, Regeneration 8th Restore Life

Basic.Effect: May add 60 points of immunities from table 3 at the start of the day.

Basic.Effect: If a Paladin able to enter the Priest Bracket then their Paladinic Bless increases by 1.

Basic.Effect: Grants complete immunity to any emotional effect or attack that would cause the Talthar member to despair or lose hope in any fashion.

Basic.Effect: White Spell Invisibility but only hides the user from Spirit Sight (Active & Passive) and goes down under the same conditions

Basic.Effect: +1 Meditation Rate, abilities post triple rate can use this as a pre-requisite

Acts in a manner similar to the miracle Befriend Spirit, except that all those present when used, who hear the casting, are affected. Targets remain befriended for 5 minutes or until any violence occurs, whichever comes first. This will only affect targets with 8th level resistance to spirits or lower, and even then Immunity to Befriend applies.

Basic.Name: Justice
Basic.Effect: 20ft range. May be used upon anyone who has just cast an evil miracle {within the last 30 seconds}. Target suffers 3 TBLP (1 HTK) for each spirit point of the evil miracle (e.g. someone who has just cast a Touch of Death would suffer 30 TBLP). Imm. to Holy Words applies. SAC applies to this damage at 1 for 1.
