Basic.Effect: Gains +3/1 temp life every time an ally flees (i.e. leaves the dungeon) or is incapacitated in combat. Once an ally has fled from combat the character cannot then gain any additional life from them through use of this ability, for the remainder of the day. This life lasts until end of combat.

Intermediate.Name: Talthar's Resilience
Intermediate.Effect: May add 120 points of immunities from table 3 at the start of the day.

Intermediate.Name: Subtlety
Intermediate.Effect: now grants Immunity to Info Spirits / spiritual discerns that do not originate from a Worshipper of Talthar (Priest / Paladin / Devout Believer).

Intermediate.Effect:
Choose one:
i: if Restored to life instead of coming back on last 7/1 will come back totally healed of all wounds.
ii: if casting a Restore to life using their own power, not from scrolls or items (unless made by self) target will come back Totally Healed

Intermediate.Name: Unity
Intermediate.Effect: Requires 30 seconds audible and appropriate prayer (must be heard by all allies who are to be affected). For every 3 allies within 20’, all allies within 20’ gain +3/1 (max +9/3) life for the duration of the next combat that occurs. This ability counts & benefits only those allies who spend the entire 30 seconds of casting time within the 20’ radius.

Intermediate.Name: Serenity
Intermediate.Effect: For 1 TBLP, touch acts to calm a ravaged spirit for as long as the priest remains in contact with the target: Reduces the severity of a Spasm (or similar effect) to the stage where a victim may lay still or prevents the effects of an insanity which would cause disruptive behaviour, e.g. not a cataleptic state

Intermediate.Name: Diplomacy
Intermediate.Effect: Mass Pacification (as Pacification), but is Spiritual in nature and effects all within 20’ of the caster.

Intermediate.Name: Justice
Intermediate.Effect: Touch range. May be used upon a goodly target, who is suffering from a published evil spiritual effect, provided the caster of that effect is within 20’ of their victim. The effect is removed from the target and instead affects the person who cast it. If the caster of the evil effect is immune to it, or immune to Holy words, this ability has no effect and the original victim still suffers from the effect.

Intermediate.Name: Adversity
Intermediate.Effect: 33% Rage vs Evil

Advanced.Name: Talthar's Resilience
Advanced.Effect: May add 180 points of immunities from table 3 at the start of the day.

Advanced.Name: Subtlety
Advanced.Effect: Immunity to Informational Spells now grants Immunity to info Magic that does not originate from a Worshipper of Talthar (Priest / Paladin / Devout Believer). Gains an additional Hidden From Sight innate.

Advanced.Name: Renewal
Advanced.Effect: 1 in every 6pts of spiritual healing received from a Talthar Priest / Paladin will heal damage that is otherwise incurable or permanent. (But only damage suffered on that event).

Advanced.Name: Unity
Advanced.Effect: Anyone meditating within 20’ of the point of casting does so at +1 additional meditation rate. This ability lasts as long as the caster meditates and remains within the area of effect.

Advanced.Name: Serenity
Advanced.Effect: Regains 1 spirit every 15 minutes the character remains “serene” regardless of meditation rate. This is broken if the character suffers harm, casts, attacks, moves faster than a slow walk, or uses any other ability that requires concentration.

Advanced.Name: Diplomacy
Advanced.Effect: Requires the user to speak in a peaceful and calming manner for 30 seconds (additional 1 level, cumulative for every 10 seconds spent speaking). Acts in a manner similar to the miracle Befriend Spirit, except that all those present when used, who hear the casting, are affected. Targets remain befriended for 5 minutes or until any violence occurs, whichever comes first. This will only affect targets with 8th level resistance to spirits or lower, and even then Immunity to Befriend applies.

Advanced.Name: Justice
Advanced.Effect: When using a Justice holy word, the victim is now freed of the evil spiritual effect even if the caster is immune to it but not if the caster is immune to Holy Words. Gains an additional Holy Word “Justice!” innate.

Advanced.Name: Adversity
Advanced.Effect: When fighting an opponent who is inflicting a greater damage grade than the Talthar worshiper, they gain +1 Damage Grade and +1 Max Damage versus that opponent.

Church of the Tryst.PreRequisites: Any Evil Priest can join this guild.
Church of the Tryst.Ethos:
The Tryst is a church that takes spiritual power from the Imbaiu demons. It is important to understand that the church do not serve the Imbaiu, but binds, dominates and commands them. References to the Imbaiu Masters refer to those Imbaiu with mastery over lesser demons. The Imbaiu Masters that accept the bindings of the church do so because this link to Primus gives them strength upon their own worlds that they use to remain at the top of their demonic hierarchy.

PRE-REQUISITES Any Evil Priest can join this guild.

MIRACLE LIST 1st Halt, Power Meld, 2nd Cause Wound, Spirit of Seeing and Hearing 3rd Curse, Talk to Spirits, Spirit Shield, Cause Serious Wounds, Protection From Spirits 4th Spirit Shift, Spirit Bolt, Cause Disease, Create Ghoul 5th Spiritual Invisibility, Cause Grievous Wounds 6th Control Wraith, Serin’s Bound Spirit of Undeath, Walk Through Walls 7th Suspend Life

Basic.Name: Shadow of the Imbaiu
Basic.Effect: allows the priest to invoke the shadow of an Imbaiu to share their form. This takes 30 seconds and grants them 1/2 effect all bar spirit for 5 minutes. While active discerns as a demon kind and if banished the power ends.

Basic.Name: The ways of Mephastofolies
Basic.Effect: gains bar spirit on base list while battle boarding the church.

Intermediate.Name: The dark bargains
Intermediate.Effect: takes 1 minute to open a link to the Imbaiu costing 24 TBLP of the casters blood/essence in sacrifice. Acts as a mantic comm 2 but each question asked costs the user a level (c .f. casting a TOD , but reductions in level loss from casting miracles do not apply).

Intermediate.Name: Shadow of the Imbaiu
Intermediate.Effect: allows the priest to invoke the shadow of an Imbaiu to share their form. This takes 30 seconds and grants them a spirit form 5 minutes. While active discerns as a demon kind and if banished the power ends.

Advanced.Name: Invoke the abysmal power
Advanced.Effect: Can turn a published evil miracle demonic (black/red/evil spirit) taking 10 seconds ritual/calling on the Imbaiu per spirit of the miracle. If used for a TOD/animate life/similar miracle that requires a prot this also allows the prot to be cast mantically (taking an extra 30 seconds prep).

Advanced.Name: Shadow of the Imbaiu
Advanced.Effect: Now acts as a full embody abashi (including disadvantages) but does not grant 12 spirits.

Church of Condesecration.PreRequisites:
• Any Evil Priest Subclass, Hermits and the alike may choose to keep their own lists, Unholy Champions may also join.
• Any member that worships a God of their own free will, will be excommunicated.
Church of Condesecration.Ethos:
A Dark faith built upon the darkest whispers of the world, this church worships the malevolence woven into the fabric of existence itself.
Core Belief: The world is a tainted and imperfect place, not because of chance, but because darkness is intrinsic to its nature. Evil spirits are not aberration - they are the world’s architects, unseen but ever-present.
The hearts of men, with greed, hatred and ambition, are merely conduits for this eternal corruption. To resist is folly, to embrace is power.
It was through Treare The Ghoul Lord's teachings that when Lord Waste left, it was him that swore never to follow a god again and find the true path to power, strength through the darkness that lives in all souls and this is what followers draw upon.
Corruption Is Truth: Purity is a myth fed to the weak. All things decay, and the strong must harness the inevitable rot.
The Will of Shadows: Evil spirits, lurking beyond mortal sight, whisper their desires into the ears of men, the faithful must listen and act.
Last words of the High Priest: Darkness is everywhere, bind it and learn control. Killing randomly and without thinking is disliked by the current leadership and harming peons is such a waste as they are a source of our strength.

Basic.Name: Drain Soul
Basic.Effect:
Gains Slayer (as tables). If already owned, then 1/day can use a slayer to gain one of the following: 
• 12/12 evil spiritual cure serious wounds
• 2 spirits back
• regain a level lost for casting an evil miracle

Basic.Name: Deny Healing
Basic.Effect: Adds a 6th level miracle to base list that acts as deny power, but only functions vs healing miracles.  Verbal is `Waste denies thy gift!`

Intermediate.Name: Drain Soul
Intermediate.Effect:
Gains Slayer (as tables). 1/3 hours can use a slayer to gain one of the following: 
• 12/12 evil spiritual cure serious wounds
• 2 spirits back
• regain a level lost for casting an evil miracle.
 If Slayer is already owned, can use this 1/hour

Intermediate.Name: Draw on the Suffering
Intermediate.Effect: with 30 seconds preperation, can reverse the effects of a causing miracle cast on the user by a Condesecration member, so that it heals the base amount of damage it would cause. Suspend Life heals 72/72 for these purposes.

Intermediate.Name: Take this, Elf
Intermediate.Effect: Can cast a handbook causing miracle 'mantic (black mana) vs an elf or similar (not an elemental or mana formed human, for example).

Advanced.Name: Take this, Elf
Advanced.Effect:
Can cast a handbook causing miracle 'mantic (black mana) vs an elf or similar (not an elemental or mana formed human, for example).
 Can spend both innates to enhance a published causing miracle to be mantic (black mana)

Advanced.Name: Armour of Waste
Advanced.Effect: Grants immunity to baneful causing (anything resistance to causing would apply to or is a miracle in the causing sphere) - lasts 5 minutes.

Advanced.Name: Deny Healing
Advanced.Effect: Adds a 4th level miracle that acts as deny power, but only functions vs healing miracles. Verbal: `Waste denies thy gift!`

Church of the Destroyer.PreRequisites: Be a priest or ley-believer of the Destroyer. Hermit priests may join and become full members and may choose to retain their own miracle lists.
Church of the Destroyer.Ethos:
In the beginning was The Creator. The first word he spoke was the Word of Creation, forming The Goddess of Creation. She created the universe and created all of the angels. However, everything created by the Goddess is imperfect. The Creator saw that this was wrong, with only the force of Creation there could be no change, everything was in stasis so there could be no life. So, the Creator spoke the second word, the Word of Destruction, and The Destroyer was formed. Only through Destruction can impurity be cleansed. Destruction drives change and perfection. Many of the Angels decided to follow the force of Destruction, and they became Abashai. The forces of Creation and Destruction are forever locked in battle. We serve a higher purpose; we are not just mindless killers (well not all of the time) and there must be a balance. Many groups, such as the St Michael's Church, mercenaries, goodly faiths and the Knights of the Land have upset this balance. It has been pushed too far towards the forces of Creation and we need to strike back.

PRE-REQUISITES Be a priest or ley-believer of the Destroyer. Hermit priests may join and become full members and may choose to retain their own miracle lists.
Church of the Destroyer.Restrictions: The Guild is a full black guild (as per WFA rules).

Basic.Name: Obliterate the spirit
Basic.Effect: Vs a non -animate spirit (so not an Undead , but could be an active miracle, line etc.) with 30 seconds clear prayer to the destroyer can destroy the spirit (in a similar manner to a dispel). This is a non-published dispelling effect for immunity purposes and costs the user 3 TBLP per spirit of the miracle destroye d (or 60 TBLP if it does not have a level). Range 10ft, and can only target one spirit (if a line has more than one spirit in it this destroys one of them).

Basic.Name: Word of Destruction
Basic.Effect: As per the published Unholy Word for causing, except does not affect Destroyer worshippers.

Intermediate.Name: Prayer of Destruction
Intermediate.Effect: Takes 30 seconds prayer over a dead body that had a spirit. Acts as per a slayer, but if successful also heals the user 3/3 per level of resistance the victim had. 1/2 a spirit and similar does not increase the healing gained, instead it actually halves it. A dead person can only be affected by this once.

Intermediate.Name: Feed on Suffering
Intermediate.Effect: With 30 seconds prep can cast a causing miracle on self and instead be healed half the amount it would normally inflict (before resistances). Only works with damaging miracles.

Arcanum.PreRequisites:
1st Class Wizards and High Wizards may join freely. All other 1 st or 2nd class wizard subclasses (including 2nd class Wizard, Warlock, Rogue, Power Master, Sorcerer, Vivomancer / Necromancer) may join with the Principal's (Guild Sire's) permission. This must be signed onto their character card.

No one who is outlawed for party killing may join or remain a member of the Arcanum without the direct permission of the guild master.
Arcanum.Ethos: The Arcanum is an independent college teaching the magical arts, closely linked to the Enclave. It is devoted to encouraging study in all aspects of magic, and seeks to produce mages who are well-rounded in their knowledge of the art in all its forms.

Basic.Name: Meta Magic:
Basic.Effect:
Any member who would not normally be able to do so (e.g. if pathed or cannot cast grey) is now capable of casting the Dispel 1, 2, and 3 glyphs.
Members who can cast these glyphs may spend 30 seconds in calm, quiet observation before casting a Detect Magic, at which point it functions as per the advanced grey g lyph Improved Detect Magic instead.

Basic.Name: Scholarly Interest
Basic.Effect: 1/Day a member may examine a source of magic identified by Rec Mana, at 1” range. For every 30 seconds they examine the source of mana they gain a Magical Major Prayer about this source i.e. may use a Major Prayer about the source, examine it for another 30 seconds and then use another and so on. During the 30 seconds concentration conversation may be held as long as it is about the source in question.

Intermediate.Name: Scholarly Interest
Intermediate.Effect: Additional use of the innate as above.

Intermediate.Name: Learned Knowledge
Intermediate.Effect: Gains 3 extra Specialist Slots. These may be filled with any glyph that could normally be learnt as a handbook specialist by that character, chosen at the start of the day.

Intermediate.Name: Understanding of Magic
Intermediate.Effect: May cast touch -range Dispels of up to 5th level for one mana less than their standard cost, to a minimum of 1 mana -point. Non -cumulative with any other cost reduction.

Intermediate.Name: Elemental Awareness
Intermediate.Effect: Whilst using Recognise Mana at 1” range it may after 10 secs concentration reveal the colour of magic. ADVANCE TIER

Advanced.Name: Greater Awareness
Advanced.Effect: Elemental Awareness now reveals the broad type of magic present (Warding, Offensive, Defensive etc.). It will also reveal if another powerbase is combined with the magic but not what it is ( e.g. a mantic effect would reveal as magical and something else).

Advanced.Name: Greater Understanding of Magic
Advanced.Effect: Understanding of Magic now applies to dispels up to 10th level.

Advanced.Name: The Towers Training
Advanced.Effect: Members gain + 1 level of casting and + 3 mana of their own colour. If they hold multiple colours they must choose which colour this applies too. Student of the Towers - Guild status Initiate of the Towers - Stage One: Cost: 50 Table: 1

Earthen Conclave.PreRequisites: Must be a first or second colour brown wizard or wizard-subclass.
Earthen Conclave.Ethos: The Earthen Conclave firmly believes that earthen magics are the bedrock of magical power, and that more can be achieved in an organisation where the members can spend more of their time devoted to sharing their knowledge of earthen magics rather than in diplomacy.

Basic.Name: Armour of Earth
Basic.Effect: Plate (O) cast on self grants MAC 6 / PAC 6.

Basic.Name: Grounding 1/ day
Basic.Effect: Whilst in contact with Earth or stone grants complete immunity to one blue mana or electric attack.

Basic.Name: Alliance of Earth
Basic.Effect: 1/ day: Remove a Brown spell currently on them for 1 TBLP per MP (Max 12 TBLP) or negate it as it happens, for 2 TBLP per MP (to a max cost of 18 TBLP). Verbal: “The Earth is my ally!”

Intermediate.Name: Passage
Intermediate.Effect: As a cantrip may release a Wall of Stone that the Talthar member has previously cast. Range 20'. Verbal: “Gnomes of Earth I release thee”.

Intermediate.Name: Earthen Armour
Intermediate.Effect: Tables Immunity to Electricity.

Intermediate.Name: Grounding
Intermediate.Effect: 2nd daily innate as above.

Intermediate.Name: Earthen Window
Intermediate.Effect: 1/ day for 5 minutes member can see through a Wall of Stone they cast if they remain in contact with the wall.

Advanced.Name: Grounding
Advanced.Effect: 3rd daily innate as above.

Advanced.Name: Earthen Window
Advanced.Effect: 2nd daily innate as above.

Advanced.Name: Conducting
Advanced.Effect: Grounding can be used on electric or blue mana attacks within 20' of an Earthern Conclave member.

Advanced.Name: Might of Rock
Advanced.Effect: The Wizard's Grimoire Rock Skin spell also grants a resistance to Sever/loc to zero.

Advanced.Name: Sure Footed
Advanced.Effect: grants Stability whilst in contact with Earth or Stone.

Frontline.PreRequisites: Must be a first class Warrior Subclass. Second class Warrior Subclasses may join with the guild master’s permission
Frontline.Ethos: The Frontline is intended to be just that. A band of warriors who stand foremost in battle, unyielding and unafraid so that fellow mercenaries can have faith in their sword arms. The guild was formed by Jessiah Blackheart and Kaldon to face the threats of the day with the best training that money and time could buy. However, when they lost interest as their status rose above such things, Azriel Panama took on the mantle and revived the Frontline. We welcome fighters from all walks of life, from those that enjoy the thrill of battle to the quiet yet stalwart defenders. The finesse of the duellist to the brutality of the berserker. If you fight, join us. Find your home.

Basic.Name: Additional Training
Basic.Effect: +1 warrior specialist at 8th level.

Intermediate.Name: Roll With It
Intermediate.Effect: 1/ day may roll with a weapon blow such that only takes rockskin style damage of 1pt per damage grade , must be fully aware of and able to see blow coming.

Intermediate.Name: Bulking Up
Intermediate.Effect: +12/4 temp life for the next 5 minutes, does not stack with supernaturally generated temp life.

Overrides.Effect: 1/day, gains the linked Battle Line immunities for 5 minutes and may be used in response to an effect (cf War Cry within 2 seconds).

Overrides.DisplayName: The Battle Line: Immunity to Repels
Overrides.Effect: Granted while The Battle Line is active for 5 minutes.

Overrides.DisplayName: The Battle Line: Immunity to Involuntary Mystical Transportation
Overrides.Effect: Granted while The Battle Line is active for 5 minutes.

Overrides.DisplayName: The Battle Line: Immunity to Supernatural Fumble/Disarm
Overrides.Effect: Granted while The Battle Line is active for 5 minutes.

Advanced.Name: Strength in Numbers
Advanced.Effect: Gains +3/1 status life per member of the Front line on dungeon (including self) to a max of 12/4.

The Hovel.PreRequisites: Be a hermit, witch, or other priest subclass that does not belong to a church.
The Hovel.Ethos: The Hovel is a guild made up of hermits, witches and anyone who draws power not from the gods or other patrons, instead choosing to draw power as it flows freely in the world and through personal prayer. Gathering so as to seek, to learn and teach each other. Growing more powerful together than apart. This was the concept of a strange little fellow called Raymond, who, still guides us all in the journey of life. So, feel free to join, feel free to worship as you wish... all who have no church or doctrine are welcome here.

Basic.Name: Witch's Alignment
Basic.Effect: When casting a bless or curse can choose to count as being goodly, neutral, or evil.

Basic.Name: Hovels Strength
Basic.Effect: Gains + 1 Spirit per member of the hovel on dungeon.

Basic.Name: Coven of the Hovel
Basic.Effect: The Hovel counts as a “Church” for the sharing of Scriptures of the Faith of Basic miracles. Must be battle boarding the guild to use them.

Basic.Name: Familiar
Basic.Effect: May select a suitable witches familiar and gains neutrality to natural animals of that type. Once chosen cannot be changed, so should be noted on the card .

Intermediate.Name: Hovels Strength
Intermediate.Effect: Now grants a minimum of 4 spirits.

Intermediate.Name: Coven of the Hovel
Intermediate.Effect: Now works for all published miracles within normal scripture of faith rules.

Intermediate.Name: Power Meld of the Hovel
Intermediate.Effect: If casting power meld on a fellow member of the hovel the caster/recipient levels and alignment no longer matter. Additionally the number of spirits taken can be determined at the time of casting.

Intermediate.Name: Familiar Speech
Intermediate.Effect: May now talk to animals of their familiar type as per Talk to Animal evocation.

Advanced.Name: Witches Broom
Advanced.Effect: 1/day if has a suitable Witches Broom phys rep gains a spiritual Walk on Air, and can carry up to one person. Cannot engage in melee combat while using this or it ends (probably with the witch falling off, falling only to be saved by the broom just before hitting the ground). Lasts 5 minutes or this can also be cast for 3 spirits.

Advanced.Name: Dreams of tomorrow
Advanced.Effect: Gains a pre -dungeon lucky idea about the day ahead in a visionary style. If multiple members of the guild are on dungeon they all gain the same dream but more information is gained.

Advanced.Name: Familiars knowledge 1/day
Advanced.Effect: Acts as a spiritual major prayer about witchcraft or something relevant to your familiar ( so a familiar of a Cobra could be about poison).

Advanced.Name: Wonderous Talent
Advanced.Effect: Either gains well equipped with a single dungeon temp dose of a published Wonderous Elixir , or if able to make Wonderous Elixirs can choose to be able to use on dungeon makes to make them. They do not require set up components, and take 2 of the relevant make slot per dose made.

The Inward Eye.PreRequisites: Must be a 1st Class Neuronic Class. 2nd Class Neuronicists must seek the guild masters permission to join. Outlaws/those Ostracised by the Empire of Glass (or with other legal issues with the Empire) may not join unless these issues are resolved.
The Inward Eye.Ethos:
A place for further learning and expansion of the mind within the mercenary community. A haven for those blessed with the talent of focus.

Our guild home is a space whale. Don't ask too much about it, but it's all fine. No fixed location.

Those with legal challenges with the Empire of Glass are not welcome.

Basic.Name: Internal fortitude
Basic.Effect: Gain +6 casting stamina

Basic.Name: Insight of the Mind
Basic.Effect: Gains Rec Neuronics. If owned then 1/day gains a Neuronic Major prayer about a thing identified with Rec Neuronics (and w hilst still using it).

Basic.Name: Resolute mind
Basic.Effect: A member may choose to gain one of the following benefits for the next neuronic used within 10 seconds o 2 additional foci o Reduce the casting damage by 1 (this can reduce below 1/3rd and even to 0) or (if touching another Inward Eye member) split the casting damage evenly (round up in both cases if an odd number) between both members. This is after foci/reductions

Intermediate.Name: a second use of resolute mind
Intermediate.Effect: These may be used at the same time for two benefits if desired.

Intermediate.Name: Mental Transfer
Intermediate.Effect: With 30 seconds contact with a fellow Inward Eye member, can grant them the use of one published neuronic the user of this can use. This requires casting the innate being granted (using an innate if an innate and taking casting damage). F or at will neuronics a single innate is gained.

Intermediate.Name: Inner reserves
Intermediate.Effect: 1/day can use a published neuronic that is owned as an innate even when all innates have been used for the day. Casting damage cannot be reduced and the user becomes unable to use that neuronic for the remainder of the day (even if it could be regained).

Natural Trust.PreRequisites: Must be a first class or multiclassed druid sub-class. Rangers may join and benefit as full members for 40 points on table 1. Druidic classes of any race or nationality may join, but if unable to normally do so only benefit from the Basic Tier abilities.
Natural Trust.Ethos: While members of this guild recognise that blossoming meadows and fetid fungal forests are both aspects of the natural world, they are united in opposing its wanton corruption or destruction. They will also stand shoulder to shoulder against those from other realms who would coerce or subdue the natural power of Primus for their own ends. Any member willingly breaking these broad guidelines (such as by aiding a demon seeking to sieze control of natural power on Primus) is rejected by the World Tree and may no longer use EP or EP innates whilst on Primus.

Basic.Name: Circle of Druids
Basic.Effect: For each guild member on the adventure, gains +1EP

Basic.Name: Life's Memories
Basic.Effect: Life's Memories 1/day

Basic.Name: Chosen Familiar
Basic.Effect:
Attune to an animal, requires a symbol of the creature, a piece of the creature, or incorporate that type of creatures appearance into a worn makeup design. Gain one of: 
Jump 1/day, 
Assisted Climb 1/day, 
Sniff skill, 
+1 DAC 
+1 innate PAC 
 choice should be relevant to the creature chosen.

Intermediate.Name: Circle of Druids
Intermediate.Effect: Now grants a minimum of 1 level of EP.

Intermediate.Name: Life's Memories
Intermediate.Effect: Innate Life's Memories from basic tier can now be upgraded to a Toughened Hide if desired.

Intermediate.Name: Draw on EP
Intermediate.Effect: as Alfar ability, but functions in any natural environment).

Advanced.Name: Chosen Familiar
Advanced.Effect: Now grants a second ability from the list.

Advanced.Name: Hand of Banishment
Advanced.Effect: as post 8th druid tables). When using this innate can reduce the life suffered by sacrificing levels of resistance for 1 hour. Each level reduces the life by 5.

Advanced.Name: Master of Memories
Advanced.Effect: Objects under Life's Memories from basic tier (or Toughened Hide if intermediate tier upgrade is used) are now considered master status.

Shadow Legion.PreRequisites: Be a 1st class/multi-classed Warrior or 1st class/multi-classed published Warrior Subclass.
Shadow Legion.Ethos: Whether fighting for your own beliefs or the beliefs of others there is a common bond that unites you. Through strength and honour you not only ensure your own survival but the survival of others.
Shadow Legion.Restrictions:
Must follow the Warriors code:
• Respect each other – the strength of the company aids the strength of the individual. Obey your senior officers and never leave a fallen brother on the battlefield.
• Never compromise your dignity, your pride or your beliefs.
• Always strive for a fair deal, and when one is made honour it.
• Taking any life is done with honour and dignity.

Overrides.Effect: War cry with verbal `Shadow Legion!` 1/day
Character gains 15pts of Bandage Curing. As monk loc but requires bandaging not massage.

Basic.Name: Improvised Weaponry
Basic.Effect: 1/day, the character gains the first weapon mastery in a weapon after 30 secs examination of it, lasting for the rest of the day.

Overrides.Effect: Character gains 1/3rd of their TBLP as 'bandaging', with phys-repped bandages this cures the location 1pt per 'bandaging' spent.

Basic.Name: Taking the hit
Basic.Effect:
Reduces a blow's damage to the amount called (ie 'quad' = 4 points of damage).
This is often referred to as 'rockskin', but is applied to one blow.

Intermediate.Name: Battle Training
Intermediate.Effect: either +6/2 life or +2 PAC while wearing armour or +1 DAC.

Overrides.Effect: Coldrage 1/Day
Whilst using the Shadow Legion War Cry above may also ignore other listed stopping effects for the duration for 6tblp/fx as per Determination.

Intermediate.Name: Hardened Body
Intermediate.Effect: Gains 'Hardened Body': +1 Innate PAC

Overrides.Effect: Character gains 1/3rd of their TBLP as 'bandaging', with phys-repped bandages this cures the location 1pt per 'bandaging' spent.

Intermediate.Name: Taking the hit
Intermediate.Effect:
Reduces a blow's damage to the amount called (ie 'quad' = 4 points of damage).
This is often referred to as 'rockskin', but is applied to one blow.

Advanced.Name: Advanced Battle Training
Advanced.Effect: 2nd choice from ‘battle training' above.

Advanced.Name: Legion's Blow
Advanced.Effect: 1/Day As per the Sell Sword ability ‘Primal Strike'.

Advanced.Name: Mercenary Soldier
Advanced.Effect: Choose one of the following at the start of the day.

Advanced.Name: Bandaging skill,
Advanced.Effect: as per scout skill.

Advanced.Name: Hardened Body
Advanced.Effect: Gains 'Hardened Body': +1 Innate PAC

Overrides.Effect: Character gains 1/3rd of their TBLP as 'bandaging', with phys-repped bandages this cures the location 1pt per 'bandaging' spent.

Advanced.Name: Taking the hit
Advanced.Effect:
Reduces a blow's damage to the amount called (ie 'quad' = 4 points of damage).
This is often referred to as 'rockskin', but is applied to one blow.

Sons and Daughters of Sirac.PreRequisites: Must be a gold and / or ivory mana user or creature to join, must be in the wizard bracket, but could be a gold drave brown wizard for example.
Sons and Daughters of Sirac.Ethos:
Not all are actual children of Sirac, though many in the guild are. When Sirac was first created he was commanded to go forth and spread his parents magic far and wide. He took this instruction quite…literally. But the guild is open to all who feel friendship or a family bond to Sirac, all his apprentices, and all those who are willing to serve and protect the interests of both the ivory and gold dragons, and indeed protect magic across Primus.

The guild ethos is to protect and empower the gold and/or ivory dragon and spread their magic far and wide. To generally respect and not deliberately seek to harm any mana dragon. Mocking your opposite, and even fighting their followers with sufficient cause is fine, but deliberately seeking out and trying to harm any mana drake/dragon without very good cause can be grounds to be cast out.

Basic.Name: + 3 Gold mana and + 1 Level of Casting
Basic.Effect: for Gold spells.

Basic.Name: Purpose
Basic.Effect: Gains + 3 Ivory mana and + 1 Level of Casting for Ivory spells.

Overrides.Effect: 1/day can enhance a published Ivory or Gold spell (without any non-standard enhancements) to have +50% effect if numerical (e.g. Ivory Warriors) or +50% duration if not (e.g. Ivory Armour) when cast on self or a fellow guild member.

Overrides.DisplayName: Those aligned to Harmony can cast a published self only Gold spell on a fellow guild member
Overrides.Effect: 1/day can use a published self only beneficial Gold ability on another willing guild member.

Top Secret.Ethos: This is a professional guild for scouts – any type will do. Desperate to gather as many active members as they can they open their doors far and wide. This leads to a group of sly fellows and lasses, with a variety of talents and probably too many daggers between them. Despite the variety of guildies this attracts, the guild is primarily one offering mutual support amongst its members.
Top Secret.PreRequisites:
Members must seek to support the guild and fellow guild members.

Anyone killing a fellow guild member whilst under their own free will is immediately expelled from the guild, and if on a guild special may do nothing except to seek to leave the adventure. The guild head may chose to override this.

Basic.Name: Last nights lessons
Basic.Effect: Gains a standard scout skill not owned already, or + 1 level in a skill owned (on dungeon only) to a max of 12.

Basic.Name: Ear to the ground
Basic.Effect: Acts a pre -dungeon major prayer about useful things to know, this could be equipment to have, skills to know, or anything else relevant.

Basic.Name: Evade 2/day
Basic.Effect: Grants combat wary (which must be owned) vs one blow (even if used in the last 5 minutes), must be declared within 2 seconds of the blow.

Intermediate.Name: Retreat
Intermediate.Effect: 1/day acts as a Jump away from a foe. Combat wary applies to all blows taken during the jump.

Intermediate.Name: Concealed 1/day
Intermediate.Effect: Enhance a stealth so that it grants immunity to all forms of sights. Does not work with Greater stealth.

18th Imperial Legion.Ethos: Everyone, regardless of their racial or professional background is entitled to support and security. However, the creators of Undead and daemonkind, responsible for so much of the unnecessary suffering in Labyrinthia, and known for their use of unwilling sacrifices, should be re-educated. Undead, especially the mindless creations, and daemonkind themselves should be pitied rather than reviled, and every effort spent to release them from their bondage thus allowing them to either continue their journey in peace or return to their rightful plane. Controlling of these creatures is viewed as acceptable only if it is the most efficient method of removing them.
18th Imperial Legion.Restrictions: It is expected that the spirit of the guild restrictions are adhered to, not just the letter: The 'wilful' killing of living creatures from this world or any other should be regarded as a last resort and to attack a truly defenceless creature, unless that creature is Undead or similarly irrevocably evil, without due compassion is to be avoided. Similarly, members are discouraged from 'wilfully' striking any helpless target unless that creature is Undead or similarly irrevocably evil or still posing a threat. Any member that does so of their own volition without due cause will suffer a perm -2 pt curse of conscience to which Immunity to Curses does not apply. Guild members will be ready to lend aid and assistance to their fellow members. Any disagreements should be resolved as peaceably as possible and never with bloodshed. To wilfully attack another fully sworn guild member will result in the offender being struck from the roles and a perm -2pt curse of conscience to which Immunity to Curses does not apply (These curses will stack with each other should multiple offences be committed by the same guild member).

Basic.Name: +6/2 Guild Life
Basic.Effect: Gains +6/2 guild life.

Basic.Name: 1st Stamina
Basic.Effect: Gains the 1st warrior Stamina.

Basic.Name: Monk Locational Curing
Basic.Effect: Gains monk loc usable only on members of the 18th legion.

Basic.Name: Together 1/day
Basic.Effect: Can only be used while on dungeon with another legion member, and is declared as a war cry. For 5 minutes gains immunity to one of the following: Fear, Emotion attacks, or Insanity.

Intermediate.Name: Together
Intermediate.Effect: Together is now a full discipline innate.

Intermediate.Name: Monk Locational Curing
Intermediate.Effect: Monk Loc now heals a like amount of TBLP.

Intermediate.Name: The Empire's Strength 1/day
Intermediate.Effect: For 5 minutes, gains 1/2 fx all non-weapon blows from a non-Imperial source.

Advanced.Name: +12/4 Guild Life
Advanced.Effect: Now gains +12/4 guild life.

Advanced.Name: 2nd Stamina
Advanced.Effect: Now gains the first 2 Warrior Staminas.

Advanced.Name: 2nd Extra Level of Life
Advanced.Effect: Now gains the first two extra levels of life.

Advanced.Name: Together
Advanced.Effect: Together also acts as a warcry vs all stopping effects.

Advanced.Name: Tied to Bildteve 1/day
Advanced.Effect: May choose to have an undead returner (as Unholy Champion) that does not taint their body on death. If not used, can instead be triggered as an Animate Life on self (no prot or candles needed, takes 5 minutes from triggering to kick in, must rest in location it was used for 5 minutes to gain the total heal).

Basic.Name: Shield of the Meek
Basic.Effect: No normal non -evil peon will attack the guild member, as they are supernaturally guided away from doing so by the forces of Light. Guild members are aware of these peons, and should they strike or injure one they are immediately cast ou t from the guild.

Basic.Name: Inspiration
Basic.Effect: Guild member may grant one non -evil person an additional live to minus 6, which will stack with their own live to minus (but not guild abilities). This may be the guild member themselves if desired. If it not self, requires 30 seconds of friendly or inspiring conversation with the benefi ciary.

Basic.Name: Turn Away the Evil
Basic.Effect: 1st Innate of a mantic Repel Supernatural Evil – as per the paladinic ability to repel evil – but will only work on evil supernatural creatures such as demons and Undead

Intermediate.Name: Words of Comfort 1/day
Intermediate.Effect: May touch a single target and act as a Mantic Hearten and Pacification on the target for as long as the guild member remains touching them and focussing on them. This ends if the recipient or the guild member take any damage or use any powers.

Intermediate.Name: Words of Harmony 1/day
Intermediate.Effect: Acts as per the Hospitaller ability Voice of Reason.

Advanced.Name: Wisdom in the Words of Light
Advanced.Effect: Until the next dawn any person that has been affected by at least 60 seconds of “Words of Harmony” gains benefits as per Inspiriation (basic tier) unless evil. If that person is a non -evil peon, then the live to minus is doubled. The user of this innate also gains death link to all those affected – revealing the location, time and nature of their death (is a mantic information effect).

Advanced.Name: Words of Harmony 1/day
Advanced.Effect: Acts as per the Hospitaller ability Voice of Reason.

Advanced.Name: a third Turn Away the Evil
Advanced.Effect: May use all three innates at the same time to act as a Hand of Banishment style effect which specifically only works on supernatural evil creatures which could in general terms affect the user – so an Elf could not banish a Wight – but a human could. If this ability is successful then they suffer 10TBLP per resistance level that the creature had.

Children of the Dusk.PreRequisites: Elves, Half elves, faeries, draves, half draves, drowe and half drowe may all join freely. Any other spiritless creature may join with the guild heads permission.
Children of the Dusk.Ethos:
The Children of the Dusk are a gathering of peoples and creatures who primarily originate from the magical world, however all share the lack of a spirit. We have all come together to aid one another, whether it be through having

an item made, having a friend on a mercenary mission or simply to share a mutual goal of gaining power and strengthening our magical sources.
Children of the Dusk.Restrictions: Generally speaking members must try to strengthen the guild and hold up to its ethos. Working to weaken magic/the dragons/sources of power will have you cast out of the guild. Depending on the severity of your actions this may happen immediately at the refs discretion.

Basic.Name: Draw on Magic
Basic.Effect: 2/day ~ May expend “X” mana of racial innates ( max 12) to cure a guild member (not self) X TBLP/Loc damage.

Basic.Name: Evade Death
Basic.Effect: 1/day ~ First time the guild member would die on TBLP they may instead fall unconscious and gain a stacking live to minus 12 TBLP. To use this costs them 6 mana of racial innates.

Basic.Name: Magic is magic init?
Basic.Effect: may expend up to 6 mana of racial innates to regain a racial innate of up to 6 mana.

Advanced.Name: Explosive Death 1/day
Advanced.Effect: Upon death can expend X mana of racial innates (these are used) and cause their slayer to suffer TBLP damage equal to three times the mana expended (1 hit to monsters per 3 TBLP). MAC applies at 1 for 1 and the damage is of the colour of innates used. This is a dying effect.

Council of Jade.PreRequisites: Must be an Amlesian race/class. Upon entry the character must decide upon their clan (Dragon, Crane, or other clan that is a member). This must be written on card upon entry. Members cannot belong to a Clan that is not part of the council (e.g. Panama or Snake)
Council of Jade.Ethos: Having tired of the almost lawless squabbling of the Clans, both Great and Low, the Dragon, Crane and Snake Clans came together with joint effort to form the Council of Jade, a coalition that is now a force for Law and Order in the Jade Empire. The Council acts as a place for the clans meet and train together and share techniques for the betterment of all. The Council works for the betterment of life in the Jade Empire for all that live there and fights tirelessly to keep the lands safe for its inhabitants. After recent events the Ox and Lion clans have joined and the Snake Clan has departed the council.
Council of Jade.Restrictions:
Modern Laws- No member of the Council of Jade may be outlawed, if they become so they no longer gain any benefits until the crime is resolved at which time they may appeal to the Council for full membership again (only by the Guild Sire’s approval).

Unified Council - No member may attack or bring purposeful harm to another member, should this come to be they lose all benefits until the incident is resolved at which time they may appeal to the Council for full membership again (only by the Guild Sire’s approval). Any disagreements will be civilly dealt with by the Leaders of the Council; their decision is final in every case. The only exception in this rule will be cases of Seppuku. All cases of this restriction can be judged and dealt with by the Council Leaders in the same fashion as the outlaw restriction

Once Clan always Clan - Once you have joined the Council you may never leave unless expelled by a unified vote of the council (rebirthing releases you also).

Earthsunder.PreRequisites: Be a non-evil dwarf, not outlawed or ostracised - evil dwarfs may join with the Thane’s permission provided this is discussed first, and they are not chaotic in alignment. Duregars cannot under any circumstances join this guild (no exceptions). Werewolves regardless of race may be considered for lay membership due to the history between these races and the support, understanding and pacts which have been formed in the past. (As an OOC note – Werewolves DO NOT gain guild benefits).
Earthsunder.Ethos: To defend the Clan and its members and allies. We protect our home, families and each other. The Clan comes first, by working as one, we bring prosperity to all.
Earthsunder.Restrictions:
For the people: The people come first, we are the guardians and protectors above all. To bring destruction or wilful harm to the people will result in immediate and unequivocal exile from the clan, resulting in being ostracised when dealing with dwarves only.

For the clan: The clan home is always important and second only to the people. Wilful betrayal of the clan will result in exile as above.

A guild member that has been outlawed by the seers for party killing may remain with the Thane's permission.

Basic.Name: Strength of the Hearth
Basic.Effect: Members gain + 3/1 life.

Basic.Name: A Strange Sense
Basic.Effect: When using the racial evaluate members gain an instinct if there are supernatural qualities to an object, or something more than its grull value. They do not gain exact details just a sense that there is something there.

Intermediate.Name: Strength of the Heart
Intermediate.Effect: Now gains +6/2 life.

Advanced.Name: Well Armoured
Advanced.Effect: When wearing Master crafter metal armour gains + 1 Max A/C and the armour grants an additional point of PAC.

Overrides.Effect: When a member of the guild is unconscious or incapacitated, gains +6/2 life. This lasts 5 minutes or until the threat is resolved, even if the guild member becomes active again.
When a member of the guild is unconscious or incapacitated, gains an innate War Cry. This lasts 5 minutes or until the threat is resolved, even if the guild member becomes active again.

Advanced.Name: Eyes of the Deep
Advanced.Effect: 1/day for 5 minutes upgrades the Dwarves natural ability to see in the dark to act as per Senseless Vision.

Advanced.Name: Denounce the Magic
Advanced.Effect: 1/day for 5 minutes enhance the dwarves racial ½ effect magic to grant complete immunity to magic. This cannot be ended early.

The Highborn Assembly.PreRequisites:
Must be a non-outlawed character prepared to work towards the greater good of all planes of existence and those in need. The greater good relates to the continuance of our existence, accepting that Primus does not exist in isolation, and that the bearing of other worlds impacts our own for good or ill, and often requires our intervention. A member of the Highborn Assembly should be prepared to lay down their lives in order to achieve the safety of all.

No evil characters, Undead or demons - Whilst this guild does not specifically discriminate against such individuals, so long as they continue to act in ways such that they defend Primus, its people and beyond, it is less likely that such individuals are able to adhere to the self-sacrificing and heroic nature of this organisation. Exceptions surely exist, but in the interests of keeping the Highborn Assembly as one that stands apart from others this restriction is now in place.
The Highborn Assembly.Ethos:
Primus sits at the centre of a tumultuous universe, with the power flowing through the Throne of Glass drawing the attention of multiple planes of existence for good and ill. History has shown many races seeking refuge here, and many other creatures seeking to control or destroy us. For our own part, we have ventured beyond our world to help others or defeat our enemies with strength and purpose for generations.

The Highborn Assembly seek to protect those that need it, regardless of place or even plane of origin. We do not exist in isolation; the death of another world impacts upon our own.

Basic.Name: Heroic Stand
Basic.Effect: 1/day ~ Grants one member of the guild (does not have to be the person using the benefits) the benefits as per Illusions of Grandeur but it is physical in nature and not an insanity. Lasts 5 minutes as normal.

Basic.Name: The Greater Good
Basic.Effect: 1/day ~ Acts as a lucky idea about a “plan” and if it is broadly beneficial or dis - beneficial to the greater good.

Intermediate.Name: Take Killing blow/effect for a peasant/innocent type at own resistances
Intermediate.Effect: 1/day

Intermediate.Name: Discipline
Intermediate.Effect: 1/day as per Discipline.

House D'treal.PreRequisites: Must be a member of, or retainer to House D’treal. Other individuals can join by completing a guild special (or other relevant dungeon) to the satisfaction of the Guild head or Head of House.
House D'treal.Ethos: The Guild is dedicated to the strengthening of the Empire of Glass, and through it House D’treal itself. Members are expected to respect the ancient pacts and patrons the House has amassed over time, while embracing the modern world and the House’s place within the Empire.
House D'treal.Restrictions: Those individuals with legal issues with the Empire (Outlaw, Wolfshead, Ostracised etc.) can only remain a member with the Guild Heads permission. Individuals found to be acting against House D’treal or the Empire may be cast out of the guild by the Guild Head, and cannot re-join without the guild heads permission.

Basic.Name: Ancient Family Pacts
Basic.Effect: Once per day member of House D'treal can call on the House's extensive catalogue of pacts to announce a published ancient folk pact. They gain this pact for 5 minutes and if they do not have a level for pacts it is gained at 8 levels.

Basic.Name: Pact with the Dragons
Basic.Effect: The House has Pacts with all the Dragons and Drakes ; this grants the house member one rune of a pact with a Dragon or Drake (4 Levels) of their choice (chosen at the start of the day) as per the published spell. To cast the rune requires 30 seconds invoking the dragons power.

Basic.Name: Power behind the Throne
Basic.Effect: The D'treals have a great deal of clout in the Empire due to their elevated status and large numbers of Nobles, 1/ day acts as a Befriend versus any NPC Imperial Official as they realise that getting in with House D'treal may help their career.

Khaniabad Archaeologist and Cartographer.PreRequisites: Have some skeletons in your closet! No fascist goodly types except Reast. We know your type and you’ll be turned away. If in doubt, turn up, be judged. Goodly people must be signed in to join.
Khaniabad Archaeologist and Cartographer.Ethos: The charismatic face of a bunch of lowdown, scum of the earth types with a penchant for robbing tombs, breaking skulls and casual murder. Whereas more upstanding guilds are in it for clan or country, or “defending the land”, or similar weak, easily subverted ideals, there’s none of that nonsense in the Society. People are in the Society because they want power or riches or a place to hide from whatever dirt is in their past. And frankly it’s much easier to be the one giving out the beats if you have a bunch of other nasty pieces of work at your back. Sometimes the Society works for other people but mostly it works for itself, capitalising on opportunities members might find.
Khaniabad Archaeologist and Cartographer.Restrictions:
Only available to people interested in the myth of Khaniabhad, sharing tales of the city if they have briefly managed to see it, hopeful of meeting a Khazak or just wanting to emulate a notorious Denizen!

No middlers. Contribute or get kicked out.

Being part of this Society is a criminal offence in the eyes of the Confederecy. This doesn’t result in outlawhood or ostracism, but it does come up on relevant criminal discerns.

Basic.Name: Are you sure this is a good idea? 1/day
Basic.Effect: Gains a ref triggered lucky idea if a fellow guild member is about to do something that could have bad consequences.

Basic.Name: We're in this together 1/day
Basic.Effect: Acts as per war cry but can be used on other guild members at 20ft range.

Basic.Name: What did we all bring to the party
Basic.Effect: At the start of the day gains an item of a 1st to 3rd level handbook miracle, or 1st to 4th level standard spell. These are chosen by the ref and should be useful on the dungeon. The items can only be used a member of t he guild, who requires the relevant utilise skill. Additionally the item cannot be used by the person that arrives on dungeon with it .

Intermediate.Name: There's a short cut in this ward 1/day
Intermediate.Effect: Acts as a mantic evasion vs one warding. If already has similar (EG Ghost and the relevant immunities) then can use this innate on a fellow guild member at touch range.

Advanced.Name: Knowledge of the Cults
Advanced.Effect: If in Khannibad gains a major prayers worth of broad info if meets a new Cult, Sect, or group. This is public knowledge about their aims, and it might be nothing, and it is likely all guild members will gain the same information.

Advanced.Name: Look Reast Trusts Me 1/day
Advanced.Effect: For 5 minutes counts as being Neutral rather than evil for effects that target the guild member based on alignment (EG immune to repel evil, answers neutral to auric colour, is effected by soul lance).

Knights Errant.PreRequisites: Open to any non-evil individual. Evil individuals must complete a guild special to the satisfaction of the guild master before being allowed to join.
Knights Errant.Ethos: Formed in Farrels Fall the Knights began their quest following in the footsteps of a ghostly wandering knight. He lead them on a great quest that revealed the hidden secrets of an ancient order of knights attuned to the spirits of light and the elements. The Knight Errants have taken up the quest of ensuring the Demonic masters called the Dark remain imprisoned and that the deeds of the four champions are not forgotten.
Knights Errant.Restrictions:
Never Act without reason – All things should be done with purpose and intention. Everything has a value, but not always a price – All things hold value to someone, and this should be considered when acting. However just because something holds value does not mean it can be traded or have a price set to it.

If there has been a wrong, there can be no peace – The core of the heroisim for the order. Where they find wrongs have been done they will not rest until they have been righted, or those responsible dealt with.

Basic.Name: Ward against the darks
Basic.Effect: 1/day ~ Grants the user ½ effect one of: fire, Electricity, green mana, or brown mana for 5 minutes .

Basic.Name: Never act without reason
Basic.Effect: Acts as per a discipline innate, but only lasts for 30 seconds.

While active the weapon also inflicts Flaming, Electrical, Water, and Earth based damage (of the chosen power base). ~

Knights of The Land.PreRequisites: In joining the knights you swear a vow never to attack another member of the guild. Should you break this vow, accidentally or otherwise, the Lord Knight or a majority vote of Lords of Orders can cast you out of the guild for treachery – thus it can be very important to be sure who you are hitting in the dark! It is rare that Tribal creatures can join as they normally cannot understand / keep to the vow. If they are able to and are willing to then they may join the Knights of the Land.
Knights of The Land.Ethos:
The Knights exist to protect the Land, now commonly referred to as Primus, and its people. In order to better function as an order, the Knights treat one another as brothers, seeking at all times to protect and nurture our fellows. This, however, does not hold more importance than the fundamental reason for our existence – the

protection of the Land and its people. No cause, whether religious or political, can take precedence over this. Thus, whilst anyone is welcome to join the Knights, there will always be those whose views and (more importantly) activities are not compatible. It is not, for example, fitting behaviour for a Knight of the Land to sacrifice innocent peasants to dark gods. Furthermore, the Knight’s brotherhood is not a hiding place for those who seek only safety for themselves.
Knights of The Land.Restrictions:
• You must not harm knights directly or indirectly and are required to help each other to the extent of sharing all equipment during an adventure, acting honourably and without treachery at any time.
• A knight will never hide his membership as it is a thing to be proud of.
• Anyone ostracised, outlawed or Wolfshead in any place (Empire, Amles, Ishma, Baronies etc) must have the current Lord Knight’s permission to join – or remain a knight (must be signed on to character card).
• Any individual who is completely immune to comms/info effects must be signed in/have their membership of the Order’s countersigned by the current Lord Knight, Lord Unity, or Lord Seeker.
• Members are no longer cast out for striking a Knight, only willing killing them.
• Treachery is defined as working against another Knight, or the oath.
• No level or points are earned from an adventure if a fellow knight is left behind on an adventure, dead or alive. If this does happen then the Lord Knight and the GSM must be notified by the referee. They will then discuss if this warrants casting out or not.
• It should be clear that once a Knight of the Land has been ‘cast out’ for whatever reason they may not rejoin the guild.
• At the beginning of each adventure each knight must announce their presence by clearly and audibly affirming their oath: “Shield on arm, sword in hand, Brothers together, we defend the land” Failure to perform as above may result in the knight being ~ cast out ~ as detailed below:
• They may never again be Immune to Fear.
• All previous Knight of the Land abilities are applied in reverse.
• Any knight cast out for cowardice will never be able to use a sword or shield again. Cowardice involves leaving another Knight of the Land behind on an adventure (alive or dead)
• Any Knight who refused aid to another Knight or is cast out for for acts of treason will never again be able to use strength in combat.
• Any Knight cast out for acts of treason also suffers -6 max. AC to attacks to their back, from surprise or from range. The Lord Knight has decreed that those outlawed for party-killing may not remain members of the guild. The only circumstances in which there may be clemency are if the killing occurred in defence of a Knight of the Land, even self. If you believe this to be the case for you, speak to the Lord Knight quickly, as unless your guild membership is countersigned by the Lord Knight or the Game System Manager you may not adventure while a party-killing outlaw and a Knight. When an individual is cast out for whatever reason, the Lord Knight may choose to apply none, any or all of the “punishments” as he/she deems fit. The Lord Knight can be removed by a majority decision of the Lords of Orders, if they deem him/her unfit. This does not mean the Lord Knight is cast out, just that they are not fit for the job. The Lord Unity will act as Lord Knight until a new Lord Knight is elected. The Lord Unity/Voice must begin the election process again.

Lo'Thi.Ethos:
The Lo-Thi have many traditions and codes they follow closely and are thus almost always Lawful in their nature, rarely chaotic and never fickle.
Their dislike of the Empire however means they have little respect for its laws.
Apart from the one "Stalker" or Tribal Assassin the tribe have never been dark of heart.

The Marauders.PreRequisites: Must be a tribal creature, those that have buy as tribal somehow but are not tribal must get one of the guild heads permission to join.
The Marauders.Ethos: We are here to give all the tribes a place to be safe and grow, May also be a member of established tribes and still join, and work to regain lands to the north as our own homelands away from Imperial rule.
The Marauders.Restrictions: May not be a member of a pro Imperial guild. We are tribal’s – that’s enough.

Basic.Effect: Gains + 1 innate PAC, this is doubled against non -weapon blow attacks ( e.g. Call Lightning).

The Order of Mercenaries.PreRequisites: While open to all mercenaries, those with legal problems (Ostracised/Outlawed/Wolfshead) must have guild masters permission to join/remain a member. This open membership does not affect or apply to classes/races etc who are not permitted to join social guilds (or limited to those they can belong to).
The Order of Mercenaries.Ethos: While some gather to further a great cause, others to serve the Empire, and the most famous to protect the land, The Order of Mercenaries is formed to aid its members when conducting their daily business; adventuring. Members are expected to help each other out while on adventure together. This doesn’t have to mean giving equipment away but in general they should work together as a unified mercenary company.
The Order of Mercenaries.Restrictions: If a member kills another member the guild master may cast the individual from the guild, resulting in them being unable to join/benefit from a social guild for a year.

Basic.Name: Mercenary Problems 1/day
Basic.Effect: If has been stuck a t a line/ward/puzzle or something similar for at least 5 minutes gains a major prayer about how to solve the situation.

Basic.Name: Mercenaries Defence 1/day
Basic.Effect: Acts as per War Cry, but only applies to the effect it was used against not for 5 minutes.

Basic.Effect: Gains + 1 DAC if on dungeon with another guild member who is claiming guild benefits.

Intermediate.Name: Mercenary Solutions
Intermediate.Effect: If has used mercenary problems then for every minute still trying to solve the problem gains an extra major prayer until the problem is solved, or it 's tavern time.

Advanced.Name: Mercenaries Return
Advanced.Effect: Gains Fated Hero (as table 1). If already owned gains immunity to slayer and fortified spirit.

Panama Clan.PreRequisites: Must be a Lawful Amlesian character class, or character with Amlesian background. Non-humans may join if intelligent (able to follow law). May not belong to another Amlesian Clan. Oni are not permitted to join, or be associated with this clan, and must leave if somehow a member.
Panama Clan.Restrictions:
• Must always be Lawful of alignment.
• No insult which the offending person refuses to apologise for will ever go unavenged.
• Anyone who breaks one of these codes must report to the clan head for execution.
• No member may refuse to report to the clan head, by any means whatsoever.
• Must follow the code of the family's honour. If on adventure with guild Master failing to do so to their satisfaction means they may require execution as above. If not on adventure, character may refuse to report for execution on these grounds, in which case they are cast from the Clan as a Ronin, and may never use Forearm Parry, nor more than one mastery in a weapon. All members of Panama immediately recognise such a Ronin on sight unless the Ronin is immune to physical, magical and spiritual informational effects, and disguised.
• No contracts may be sought by any member of the clan without the authorisation of the guildmaster.
• May not become immune to the guilds disbenefits (as is true for any guild disbenefits – if you choose to join a guild you accept their disadvantages).
• In order to leave the guild in ANY fashion must have guild leaders permission to do so which must be signed on character card. If this is not done then becomes a Ronin as above. Note: Woodrow Panama has Spirit Link to all Panama members, and others loyal to the Jade Empire. If you die you are free to contact him and inform him.

Basic.Effect: 1/day . Spider Tribe.Ethos: Spider tribe goblins were once renowned for cowardice, however the prevailing side of their goblin instinct has switched. They are now nasty, stabby, sneaky lovers of ambushes (and cowards....).
Spider Tribe.Restrictions:
May only ever attack from a position of perceived strength; in most cases this will mean a helpless opponent, attacking from behind, or outnumbering the enemy.

May not leave the tribe without the permission of the chieftain.

The Swarm.Ethos:
The Swarm is a group of rats from all clans and breeds who for one reason or another have gathered together under the banner of Slavik, treating its nine tails and teachings as a totem to be respected and worshipped in their many rat ways - trying to make their mark in the world of humankind.

The tribe (for that’s what it undoubtedly is) is made up of rural nomadic rats, a mix of those pro-Thimon, and also those who do not find or accept the sewers of Thimon as the fitting "city" that they were promised.

They roam Labyrinthia gathering strength and numbers from pockets of isolated rats. Offering them protection and the feeling of the swarm - for every child of Slavik knows safety is best found in numbers.

It is through this understanding, and network of contacts, rather than gathering in the open under a large banner, or other such shows of force that these few become the many, the powerless the powerful - this is the strength and power of the Swarm.

Basic.Effect: If struck by a disease then can feed on it acting as a 12/12 cure of the same power base as the disease.

The White Wind.PreRequisites: Be goodly aligned and not an Undead or Demonkind. Guild membership must be signed on by the guild head. May not be an existing member of an imperial organisation/guild such as the Department of Collections & Recoveries or an Imperial Legion, nor join one without the express permission of the guild head.
The White Wind.Ethos:
The White Wind is a small and select group of mercenaries dedicated to the furtherment of good as and where they are needed. Willing to go bravely into the darkness and seek to triumph for the forces of light. Many members possess faith or wield powers of light but not being dedicated to a power or wielding such does not preclude one from joining their ranks.

Members of The White Wind are expected to support each other and work together to vanquish evil and strengthen to power of the Heavens.
The White Wind.Restrictions:
All members are expected to carry their guild marker with them on all mercenary missions.

No guild member may return or aid in the return of an evil being to life, the only exception being those who are redeemed at the point of their resurrection (OOC definition: No to anyone who remains evilly aligned).

A member of The White Wind that knowingly leaves behind another member be they unconscious or dead where they or their body was retrievable receives no points for the adventure.

No guild member is able to deceive or interfere with communications by guild members although being protected from communications is not an issue.

Any member that is “Black Marked” by their own actions has their membership immediately suspended and cannot claim guild benefits until the Guild Sire has reviewed the situation and countersigned their membership once more.

The Guild Sire may de-list any member he believes has not acted or does not act in the true spirit of The White Wind and need not be on adventure to do so.

Basic.Name: Ward against Sin
Basic.Effect: Declared as per a war cry and lasts for 5 minutes gains + 1 M AC, + 1 SAC, and + 1 Level of Resistance vs effects from someone evil, or that by their nature are evil ( i.e. evil miracles).

Basic.Effect: Requires a white ribbon with the guild motto on it in red spirit runes to use. 1/day with 30 seconds prep acts as either a mantic slayer or a mantic fire blade .

Church of Tsu-Ling.Ethos: The Lingists follow the Ling Chan the teachings of Tsu-Ling, Oceanic god of Peace and Tranquillity. They believe in promoting the cause of peace and aiding the lives of the common folk of Primus, protecting them from the ravages of war.

• May never use rages.
• May only attack in self defence.
• Suffers Item restrictions as Paladin.
• May only kill living creatures as a last resort.
